tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga don gsal rgyas byed ces bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ dpal rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga don gsal rgyas byed ces bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zhabs la gus btud nas/ /dngos grub 'bras bu yang dag byin pa dang*/ /mtha' dag bgegs kyi tshogs rnams nyer bcom nas/ /'gro la lhag par dge ba nyid du mdzod/ /rdo rje'i gsung gi byin gyis rlabs nas kyang*/ /bdag gi ngag tshig shin tu dri med pa/ /gzhan la phan pa'i bdud rtsis nyer bsgrubs nas/ /mtha' yas skye bo'i don chen 'grub par mdzod/ /'dir rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ni/ slob ma rjes bzung dang*/ bsnyen pa dang*/ sa chog dang*/ lhag gnas dang*/ dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga dang*/ sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang*/ slob ma dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang*/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba dang*/ slob dpon gyis dbang bskur ba dang*/ dbang gong ma rnams sbyin pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu'i cho ga te don bcu gnyis kyis rtogs par bya'o/ /de'i dang po ni/ deng sang lag len mdzad pa ma mthong la/ gnyis pa ni spyi dang mthun te/ de dag gi rnam par bzhag pa shes par 'dod na/ rdo rje gdan pa'i dkyil chog mna' mchan dang bcas par blta'o/ /gsum pa la sa brtag pa dang*/ mngon pa las bslang pa yang spyi dang 'dra mod kyi/ de ltar mi byed par snang ngo*/ /mi snang ba las bslang ba la gsum las/ dang po phyogs skyong las bslang ba ni/ gtor ma dang mchod pa bshams/ a mri ta sa bsangs/ swabhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥ hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog/bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pas mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mthas klas par gyur/

oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ pā d+yaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ dhū pe/ a lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi t+ye/ shap+ta aḥhūṃ/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma ye shes kyi rang bzhin bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hriḥ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi sny-ing ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs skyong ba bcu srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ in+d+ra sogs sbyar te/ thog mar mchod yon dang*/ zhabs bsil phul/ de nas nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags sbyar ba lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ de nas puṣ+pe sogs kyis nyer spyod lngas mchod/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha sogs kyis bstod/ shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi sogs kyis 'phrin las bcol/ mthar sa'i phyogs 'dir bdag dkyil 'khor gyi las rtsom na/ sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la stsol zhing phan pa dang bde ba'i sems kyi stong grogs khyad par can mdzad du gsol/ gang dag sdang ba dang gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa log par blta ba'i bgegs dang*/ log par 'dren pa thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig / ces brjod la tshams rngam dang rol mo'i sgra dang bcas gtor ma phyir dor ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ gtor ma gnyis pa zhig bshams la/ gong bzhin byin gyis rlabs nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa lha klu gnod sbyin srin po 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ a kā ro lan bdun gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ / gnod sbyin srin po gzhan dag la/ / sa 'di bdag gis blang bar gyis/ / dkyil 'khor don du khyod kyis stsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas gnang ba byin par bsam/ gats+tsha gats+tsha swa bhā wa naṃ/

zhes rang gnas su gshegs par bsam la/ gtor ma btang ngo*/ /gsum pa sa'i lha mo la blang ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi de nyid du lci ba'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su dri bzang gi thig le byas la/ mdun du mchod gtor gsum bshams/ gong bzhin byin gyis rlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūṃ bde chen gser gyi sa gzhi la gnas pa'i/ / sangs rgyas rnams kyis tshogs gny-is dbang bskur ba/ /gser mdog gser gyi bum pa phyag na bsnams/ /sa 'dir bdag cag tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /dbang mdzod thugs rjes bdag nyid sa yi lha/ /byang chub shing drung shākya thub pa yi/ /spyan sngar thugs dam gang bzhes de dgongs te/ /'dir byon bdag la brtser dgongs mchod pa bzhes/ /oṃ pṛ thī wi de wi a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dri'i thig le'i steng du byon par gyur/ hūṃ lha mo chen mo 'dir byon legs/ / bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ pṛ thī wi bh+yaḥ ga ga na sa ma ye hūṃ/ zhes mchod yon phul/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis khrus gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid lha mo bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ pṛ thī wi bh+yaḥpad+ma ka ma la yaṃ s+t+waṃ/ zhes gdan phul/ oṃ pṛ thī wi bh+yaḥ zhes pa thams cad la sbyar nas/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod*/ gtor ma/ a kā ro dang nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas rgya cher spel/ oṃ pṛ thī wi bh+yaḥn maḥsarba nas/ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇa daṃ bā ling ta ye swāhā/ lan gsum gyis phul/ khyod ni sa 'dzin lha mo ste/ /sku phyed thon pa gser gyi mdog /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan/ /sa 'og lha mo khyod la bstod/ /hūṃ sa la rgyu ba'i lha kun dang*/

/gang yang sa la brten pa rnams/ / sems can kun la dge don du/ /byams pa'i sems kyi gnang bar mdzod/ / ces bstod cing gsol ba btab/ oṃ ma ma rin chen sna tshogs 'dzin/ /dpal ldan he ru ka mchod ma/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang mdzod cig /sa 'dir dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ / lan gsum gsol ba btab pa gnang ba byin par mos la/ sa'i lha mo slar yang sa de nyid la thim/ sa sbyang ba ni/ lag pa g.yas pa sa la reg la/ oṃ bhu khaṃ nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur/ hūṃ laṃ hūṃ/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ yungs chu dang thal ba gtor la/ oṃ ha na ha na badz+ra krodha hūṃ phaṭa/ ces lan mang du brjod/ oṃ me dhi ni badz+ri bha wa bhan+dha hūṃ/ zhes brjod/ sa bzung ba ni/ slob dpon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i gnas su 'dug la/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i nga rgyal la gnas par bya/ phyogs bzhir rnam snang la sogs pa'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i slob ma bzhi gnas te/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas mchod pa dpag tu med pa sprul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis slob dpon la mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che sogs kyis bstod/ shar mas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ / lho mas/ mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan min thams cad yang dag spangs/ / kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa/ nub mas/ zhi ba'i chos ni mchog las byung*/ /ye shes spyod pa rnams sbyong ba/ /kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khaur dam pa/ byang mas/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med/ /kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo bsgyur/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa= zhes gsol ba btab/ de nas slob dpon gyis sems can rnams la snying rje chen po'i sems bskyed de/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams bzlas pa'i mthar thug pa sgrub thabs su ji skad bshad pa bzhin bsgom par bya'o/

/ bdag nyid kyi lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang nas/ lha'i 'khor lor gyur/ bgegs gtor gong bzhin byin gyis rlabs nas/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis bsngos te phyir dor/ hūṃ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i/ /lha la sogs pa'i bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig / gnas 'dir bde gshegs pho brang bdag 'dri yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs rigs gang yin byer bar gyis/ /de yang sa phyogs bzang po dri ma med pa nam mkha' ltar yangs pa 'dir/ bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa ming 'di zhes bgyi bas sems can thams cad kyi don du/ dpal rgyud sde chen po lnga'i dkyil 'khor 'bri bar byed na/ khyed cag 'di na gnas pa'i lha dang*/ klu dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ dri za dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ sha za dang*/ srin po la sogs pa'i gdon bgegs gang dag gnas pa de thams cad myur du dengs shig /gang dag mi 'gro bar gyur pa de thams cad dpal he ru ka'i ye shes kyi rdo rje rab tu 'bar bas mgo bo ardza ka'i dog pa bzhin du tshal pa brgyar 'gas par gyur ta re/ zhes lan gsum brjod de/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas yungs dkar gtor la bgegs bskrad/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛ h+na pa ya gṛ h+ṇa pā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wan bir+ya rā dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa dang hūṃ glur len zhing dkyil 'khor la g.yas bskor du lan gsum bskor/ oṃ ya mān+ta kri ta hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes sogs khro bo bcu'i sngags brjod cing*/ phur bu bcu khro bo bcu'i rang bzhin rnams gnas 'di nyid du gdod nas grub pa'i khro bo bcu skad cig gis byon par gyur pa rnams kyi phyag g.yon pa rnams su phur bu re re gtad*/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya gha ta ya sarba duṣ+taṃ phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ badz+ra kī la ya/ badz+ra dha ro adz+nya pa ya ti/ sarba bigh+nan kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/

ces lan bcu bzlas shing phur bu btab la/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs thams cad tshar bcad par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra badz+ra ki la ya a ko ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces phur bu brdung bar bya'o/ /phur bu rnams la so sor mchod gtor re re bshams pa'am/ thun mong du gcig bshams/ gong bzhin byin rlabs nas/ oṃ ya mān+ta kri ta sogs kyi mthar/ ar+ghaṃ nas sha p+ta'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ yang gong gi sngags rnams kyi mthar/ i daṃ bā ling gṛh+na gṛh+na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pas gtor ma phul/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad bsrung du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ mchod gtor de bsdus la bdug spos la sogs pa'i mchod pa rgyun mi 'chad par bya'o/ /rdo rje gdan pa'i dkyil chog ltar na sa chog phal che ba phreng ba sogs dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga spyi dang mthun shas che na'ang*/ grub chen khyung po'i man ngag thun mong ma yin pa dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dngul gdong ma yin pas 'dir de'i lugs bzhin du bshad pa yin no/ / gnyis pa la lhag gnas kyi sngon 'gro dang*/ lhag gnas dngos so/ dang po ni bshad pa ltar/ phyogs skyong gi gtor ma btang zhing bgegs bskrad/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs kyang gong bzhin las/ shap+ta 'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍer ṇi ta la sogs pas rol mo byin dbab/ sgrub thabs bzhin bdud rtsi byin rlabs thog mar bya/ de nas skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin las/ bdud rtsi myang ba'i skabs byin rlabs bsdus pa des chog /gong bzhin bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsdus nas/ thun mtshams kyi lha skur langs so/ /gnyis pa la/ sa'i lha mo lhag gnas/ lha lhag gnas/ bum pa lhag gnas/ slob ma lhag gnas te bzhi las/ dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gzhir/ dri'i maṇ+ḍal dri bzang gi tshom bu can mchod gtor dang bcas pa bshams/ mchod gtor gong bzhin byin gyis rlabs/

a mṛ ta sa sangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la paṃ las sa'i lha mo gser gyi mdog can zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i gser gyi bum pa thugs kar bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyi mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+rir bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbu rgyan/ gong bzhin gtor ma phul la mchod bstod bya/ mthar/ skyobs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor 'dri/ / lan gsum gsol btab la/ sa'i lha mo slar yang sa de nyid la thim/ gnyis pa ni/ gang du dkyil 'khor bya ba'i sa gzhir/ skya thig tsam btab la/ lha so so'i gnas su dri bzang gi thig le'i tshom bu bkod/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i mchod pa bshams pa'am/ bsdu na lha thams cad gshegs pa gshegs ma sems dpa' sems ma khro bo khro mo rnams su 'du bas/ mchod pa thams cad sum cu rtsa bdun bshams pa'i lag len yod pas yul dus kyi spyod pas deng sang de ltar bya mod kyi/ mchod pa ni lhag par mang ba nyid mchog go / 'jig rten las 'das pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma gnyis bshams/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po las 'bul rgyu'i gtor ma che ba nyid logs su bshams/

de thams cad bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ raṃ las nyi ma la hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje zhes pa nas/ ba dan la sogs pas brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol 'gram stegs zhes pa nas/ de rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang*/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhal med khang dbus gtsang khang phyur bu dang bcas pa lnga tshoms su gnas pa/ rta babs dang bral ba rnams so/ / de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa nas/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag nas/ 'od kyis khyab par mdzad pa'o/ / zhes pa'i bar gtso bo mtshon cha can sgrub thabs bzhin bskyed/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du/ gau rī nag mo/ nas/ sa'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ lha mo thams cad kyang spyan gsum nas dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /nang gi gzhal yas khang dbus ma'i lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar*/ byang ljang*/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad dang bcas pa'i lte ba la

nas/ gar gyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang shar ma'i nang le'u tshe dgu pa nas/ gdug pa can tshar gcod pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang lha mo'i nang gi lha snam nas/ gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa'o bar/ gzhal yas khang nub ma'i dbus su/ pad+ma dmar po nas/ gang ba'i bum pa bzhi'o/ /gzhal yas khang byang ma'i dbus kyi lte ba la sna tshogs rdo rje nas/ gang ba bzhi dang bcas pa'o/ /phyi'i gzhal yas khang gi shar sgor rta gdong ma nas/ dril bu 'dzin pa/ sgo skyong ma bzhi char yang spyan gsum dang ldan zhing*/ stag gi pags pa'i shams thabs can/ dbu skra dmar ser nas/ dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes dam tshig pa bskyed/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ sprul gzh-i bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i gzhi'i dkyil 'khor dgyes mdzad lha bcu gsum gyi bdag nyid can dang*/ rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ shar phyogs kyi nas/ at+ma ko3haṃ/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes sogs kyis bstod/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī nas/ gcig tu gyur/ mchod pa rnams gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ / bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī he badz+ra gu h+ya sa mā dzaḥtsakra sam+bha ra mahā mā ya badz+ra bhai ra wa sa pa ri wa re bh+yaḥ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa maṇ+ḍal la de bī bh+yaḥ mahā sh+ma sha na wa si ni sarba wi re ne sa pā ri wa re bh+yaḥ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha sāhā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ mchod yon zhes pa'i gnas su/ zhabs bsil/ ar+ghaṃ zhes pa'i gnas su pā t+yaṃ zhes pa sbyar/ chu gnyis 'bul ba'am/ chu bzhi 'bul ba ltar na/ thog mar zhabs bsil 'di/ gong gi mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ ni ri ti hūṃ khaṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du/ zhabs bsil dang*/ oṃ ni wi te hūṃ khaṃ swāhā/

'thor 'thung 'di/ sarba saṃ shodha ni swāhā/ mchod yon 'di/ dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ hoḥ kha raṃ mahā ar+ghaṃ pratī ts+tsha swāhā/ zhes 'bul/ me tog bzang po mdzes shing gtsang*/ / gtsang ma'i gnas skyes 'di rnams ni/ bdag gis gus pas 'bul lags kyi/ /so sor bzhes te rab dgyes mdzod/ / gong gi mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe aḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du/ yid dga' snying po ro mchog ldan/ /bdug pa bla med dri mchog 'di/ /bdag gis gus pas 'bul lags kyi/ /so sor bzhes te dges par mdzod/ /dhū pe srin po 'joms shing dag byed la/ /dges shing mun sel mar me 'di/ /bdag gis= /so sor= /ā lo ke /gtsang zhing bzang la dge ba'i dri/ /skye gnas gtsang mar ldan dri rnams/ /bdag gis= gan+dhe/ /sman rnams bcud gtsang yid gar 'ong*/ /sngags kyi zhal zas mchog 'di dag / bdag gis= nai wai t+ya/ pa ṭa ha dang cang te'u sogs/ /dung dang rnga sogs sgra dbyangs rnams/ /yid 'phrog sil snyan sna tshogs pa/ /'bul gyi yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /shap+ta/ gos zung bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bhūṃ las byung ba'i lha rdzas kyi na bza' bzang zhing rgya che ba nam mkha'i mthas klas par gyur/ kha dog bzang zhing dri zhim reg na bde/ /srab 'jam yang mdzes lha las byung ba yi/ /na bza' mchog 'di rdo rje'i sku la 'bul/ /bgres pa med pa rdo rje'i sku thob shog / gong gi mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ badz+ra was+t+ra ye āḥhūṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ zhes pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug nam mkha' gang ba spros/ oṃ wi ni badz+ri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ de bzhin du/ waṃ s+ya/ mṛ taṃ gi /mu ra dze/ ha s+ya/ lā s+ya/ girti/ nirti/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ rū pa/ rwa sa/ spar+she/ oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+ri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ de bzhin du rgyal srid sna bdun dang*/ 'dod yon rnam lnga sogs kyang spyi dang mthun par 'bul/

slar yang nang mchod byin gyis brlabs te/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ngo bo gyur pa dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ spros pa la dga' na/ khos bos brgyud 'debs logs su sbyar ba ltar/ rgyud sde lnga so so'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /bsdu na/ rdo rje 'chang*/ blo gros rin chen/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ grub pa'i dpa' bo/ shā bā ri/ gu ṇa sa ka ra rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ mai tri pa/ mi mnyam rdo rje/ mnyam pa'i rdo rje/ rin chen lha mo/ /dha byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje gdan pa/ mtshungs med rgyal mtshan 'bum/ 'jag chen byams pa dpal/ 'jam dbyangs chos dpal bzang po/ 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ rin chen mkhyen rab mchog grub/ kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ a ta ya badz+ra rā hu la gup+ta badz+ra rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ grub chen khyung po rnal 'byor/ mnyam med rin chen brtson 'grus/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa chen po/ gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ grub chen khyung po rnal 'byor/ sne'u ston pa yon tan tshul khrims/ brag nag pa rdo rje tshul khrims/ bla ma steng pa ba tshul khrims bstan pa/ bla ma bsod nams mdzes/ bla ma yon tan rgyal mtshan/ rin po che bstan pa rgyas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ mkhas grub shangs ston chos rje/ khyung po tshul khrims mgon po/ bya bral ri khrod ras chen/ shangs dkar pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mnyam med sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ grub chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rgya sgom legs pa rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog /rdo rje 'chang lha dbang grags pa dang*/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan rnams kyi zhal du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/

oṃ de ba pi tsu badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ aḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ oṃ hriḥswāhā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dh+ri ka hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūṃ hāṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhriḥhūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa rnams la 'bru gsum btags/ gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ laṃ ḍaṃ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bh+ruṃ swa a ha laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ thi liṃ oṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ gaṃ oṃ skaṃ saṃ dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ hoḥ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ oṃ ā āḥ hūṃ/ maṃ taṃ paṃ laṃ/ pu dza o a go ra de ma/ ka o tri ko /ka la ka hi/ pra gṛ so pu/ na si mā ku oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ hūṃ traṃ hri a oṃ āḥhūṃ/ yak+ṣe ma me da/ dza sa do ru/ yats+tsha ni ra/ ṇa ya ni ra oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ laṃ ḍaṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ.oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ gu ru bud+dha bodhi sa twa sa pā ri wa ra oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ k+ṣi k+ṣi tra bigh+nan bi nā ya ka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ nag po chen po'i 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥ hūṃ/ oṃ hūṃ traṃ hri a/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i tshogs kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gzhan yang gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang*/ phyogs skyong ba bcu/ lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ gza' chen po brgyad/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhi/ lha srin sde brgyad srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gnas bdag bzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa 'gro ba rigs drug dang bcas pa la mchod par 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rang gis kyang 'bru gsum gyi bdud rtsi myang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes lha thams cad bde stong gis mnyes par bsam/ de thams cad kyang 'khor gsum mi dmigs pas rgyas thebs pa de kho na nyid kyis mchod pas mchod bstod pa bsdus pa la spro na mngon rtogs bzhin bya/

long yod cing shes na bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi tas phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i rgyas pa 'di nyid bya ste/ de yang 'di ltar/ hūṃ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma sogs yongs su bskor/ /nyid kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su bsgrub/ khyod ni rgyu dang mi rgyu 'khor ba kun sgrub pa/ /snying rje'i thugs kyi sems can byang chub tu/ / kun rdzob sgyu mas byang chub sgrub pa'i yid/ /dges mdzad rdo rje dpal chen he ru ka la bstod/ /hūṃ dges mdzad rdo rje bcom ldan 'das/ / bdag med ma dang yang dag rol/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /he ru ka la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gau rī tsau rī bai ta lī/ /ghasma rī la phyag 'tshal lo/ / pu k+ka sha ri tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ ḍom+bhi ni la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /shar sgor rta gdong lho sgo yi/ /phag gdong can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub sgor khyi gdong byang sgo yi/ /seng gdong can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar gtso bo lha mor bcas/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad la/ /bdag gis gus pas bstod byas pas/ /he ru ka dpal myur thob shog /hūṃ thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams can rang bzhin gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /dgyes mdzad rdo rje bdag phyag 'tshal/ /bdag med ma yis mgul nas 'khyud/ /dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar/ /zhal brgyad po la spyan gsum po/ /mgon po de la gus phyag 'tshal/ / spyi bo dang steng nag po mdzes/ /dkar dang dmar ba g.yas dang g.yon/ /gang gi lhag pa'i zhal rnams ni/ /nag po de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /glang po rta bong glang rnga mong*/ /skyes pa khyi dang ma he can/ /g.yas pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i/ /thod pa 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /sa dang chu dang rlung dang me/ /zla nyi gshin rje gsang ba la/ /g.yon pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i/ /thod pa 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhabs bzhi yis ni bdud bzhi po/ /mnyam par mnan cing gcer bu nyid/ /nyi mar zhabs g.yas brkyangs dang sngo/

/gar mdzad de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /'khor lo bzhi yi bdag nyid mdzes/ /'dzag pa'i mgo bos rnam par brgyan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam dag pa'i/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin/ /dpral bar rigs kyi bdag po nyid/ /dam pa'i dga' ba yang dag thob/ /bde chen de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /bud med skyes 'dul 'gro gzigs nas/ / bdag med rnal 'byor ma nyid gyur/ /phyag 'os thub pa'i pha rol phyin/ /sgyu ma'i rgya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gaṃ las skyes pa'i gau ri shar/ /yan lag nag cing g.yon na nya/ /g.yas pa na ni gri gug 'dzin/ /tshangs pa mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /tsaṃ las byung ba'i chom rkun ma/ /btsod kyi kha dog lho phyogs su/ /phyag na phag dang cang te'u bsnams/ / dbang po mnan la bdag= /paṃ las skyes pa'i ser mo nub/ /ro langs ma ni nye dbang mnan/ /phyag g.yon lhung bzed g.yas pa na/ /rus sbal 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /ghasma ri ni byang gi sgor/ /ljang khu ghaṃ las byung ba yi/ /phyag gnyis sbrul dang thod pas brel/ /drag po mnan la bdag= /gshin rje mnan cing paṃ las byung/ /g.yon na dgra sta seṅge g.yas/ / dbang ldan du ni 'jigs gzugs mo/ /phyag 'tshal puk+ka si sngo la/ /ri khrod ma dkar shaṃ las byung/ /me ru gnod sbyin steng du gnas/ /g.yon na bsil byed g.yas pa na/ /dge slong 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gtum mo nam mkha'i sngo bsangs ma/ /srin por laṃ las byung ba yi/ /g.yon na thod pa 'khor lo g.yas/ /phyag 'tshal srin po mnan pa la'o/ /ḍaṃ las 'khrungs pa'i g.yung mo ni/ /rlung mtshams thag bzang ris steng gshegs/ /phyag g.yon sdig mdzub g.yas rdo rje/ /sna tshogs mdog la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /skyil krungs phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs/ /phyag rgya lnga yi rnam par brgyan/ /gcer bu spyan gsum thams cad la/ /bdag ni gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /phung po khams ni rnam dag pa/ /byang chub sems las byung ba yi/

/bde rab bstir 'di thams cad la/ /dngos po kun gyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyid kyi g.yas pa'i phyag bzung ba'i/ /phyag mtshan sa bon las byung ba/ /bde chen 'dod pa thams cad la/ /rtag tu yang dag phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig nyi zla sa bon gnas/ /gnyis las skyes pa'i gtso bo rig mar bcas/ /nyid kyi nyid kyis dkyil 'khor 'di la ni/ /'jig rten gsum po sprul par mdzad dang ldan/ / nyid la 'di dag thams cad ma lus pa/ /zhi ba'i bde stsol rig ma sdud mdzad pa/ /shes rab chags pa'i bdud rtsi'i ro nyid kyi/ /gnas su zhi ba de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' 'gro ma gtso kyai rdo rje/ /lha mo 'khor lor bcas bstod pas/ /bdag gis bsod nams gang thob pa/ /des ni 'jig rten bde mtshungs shog /hūṃ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ / rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /rdo rje gsung la= /don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dag pa ngo bo nyid las byung*/ /rdo rje sems dpa' = /bcom ldan mgon po dpa' bo'i dbang phyug ni/ / sogs sgrub thabs bzhin/ bcom ldan rnam kun rdo rje phag mo chen mo ni/ / 'jig rten gsum sogs phyogs gzhan rgol bas mi thub cing*/ /'byung po'i 'jigs pa ma lus rdo rje chen pos 'joms/ /rdo rje'i gdan bzhugs tshangs sogs dbang byed las rgyal zhing*/ /rdo rje phag mo khro mo'i gzugs can drag snyems pas/ /rmugs byed rengs byed rmaungs byed las ni rnam rgyal zhing*/

/ bdud kyi 'jigs pa la sogs skem zhing pham par mdzad pa mo/ / rnal 'byor chen mo 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma la 'dud/ /skye med ngang las thugs rje chen po yi/ /keng rus 'jigs su rung ba'i ri steng du/ /bdud 'dul hūṃ las khro bo'i skur sprul pa/ /bcom ldan bde ba'i mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pa chos sku'i sprul pa ni/ /dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje yi/ /gzugs sku sgyu ma ltar ston pa/ /phag mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'byung ba bzhi po rnam dag cing*/ /ye shes bzhi yi ngo bo nyid/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang lā ma dang*/ /dum skyes ma dang gzugs can ma/ /'gro ba'i don du sku sprul pa/ /mkha' 'gro bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab gtum ma dang gtum mig ma/ /'od ldan sna chen brtan pa'i blo/ /mi thung laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ /shing grib ma la phyag= /sa bsrung ma dang 'jigs byed che/ /rlung shugs chang 'thung ljang lha mo/ /shin tu bzang dang rta sna mo/ /bya gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor shugs khaṇ+ḍa ro ha dang*/ /chang 'thung go cha rab dpa' mo/ /stobs chen 'khor lo bsgyur ma dang*/ /brtson chen ma

la= /thod pa'i dum bu keng rus can/ /keng rus mche ba gtsigs pa'i sgra/ / 'od dpag med dang rdo rje'i 'od/ /rdo rje'i sku la= /myu gu can dang ral pa can/ /dpal chen hūṃ mdzad rab bzang dang*/ /rdo rje bzang dang 'jigs byed dang*/ /mig mi bzang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stobs chen rdo rje rin chen dang*/ /rta mgrin mkha' snying he ru ka /pad+ma gar dbang rnam snang dang*/ /rdo rje sems dpar phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bzhi'i sgo rnams skyong mdzad ma/ khwa gdong ma dang 'ug gdong ma/ /de bzhin khyi yi gdong ma dang*/ /phag gdong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzugs gnyis kyis ni yid 'phrog ma/ /brtan ma mo dang pho nya mo/ /mche ba gtsigs dang 'joms ma dang*/ /gshin rje bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūṃ sgyu 'phrul chen po he ru ka /yang dag sprul pa ston 'dzin cing*/ /sku gsum ye shes ro gcig pa/ /sgyu 'phrul rgyal po la phyag 'tshal/ /mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs pa che/ /sngags kyi me tog 'phreng bas brgyan/ /sha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa/ /he ru ka dpal bdag phyag 'tshal/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lor sgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsung thugs/ / 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*/ /'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma/ /de snyed rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /༈ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /bka' yi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /bdud dang mu stegs lha min bcom/ /gshin rje 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos nyid las bzhengs ye shes sku/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas 'jam pa'i dpal/ /mngon byang ye shes longs spyod rdzogs/ /ya man+ta ka phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rigs kyi gtso/ /zhe sdang 'joms mdzad gshin rje gshed/ khro rgyal khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gshin rje gshed po rab 'jigs pa/ /gti mug rdo rje'i ngo bo khyod/

/ston pa sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gshin rje gshed po rab 'jigs pa/ /phra ma rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid/ /rdo rje'i thugs dang rab mtshungs pa/ /rdo rje rin chen phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gshin rje gshed po rab 'jigs pa/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i ngo bo khyod/ /rdo rje'i gsung dang rab tu mtshungs/ /rdo rje'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phrag dog rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po las kun byed/ /rdo rje'i sku dang rab tu mtshungs/ / phyag na ral gri phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo khyod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /sangs rgyas kun mchog gtso bo'i gtso/ /dkyil 'khor gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / gtor ma gnyis nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ so so'i sngags mthar gtor ma 'bul nas brtsams/ gats+tsha swa bha wa naṃ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin gtor ma 'bul/ mthar spos dang bcas pa'i rdo dril 'dzin pas/ rdo rje slob dpon blo gros che/ /sems can don rnams bya ba dang*/ /sangs rgyas thugs dam bskul ba'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bo rig mar bcas/ /gang yang phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang*/ /rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can/ /byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag la brtse bar dgongs nas kyang*/ /slob ma rnams la phan pa dang*/ khyed rnams la yang phan pa'i phyir/ /sang ni dkyil 'khor 'bri bar 'tshal/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la/ /de bas gnang ba mdzad par rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon brtse dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa' dgra bcom dang*/ /gsang sngags lha gzhan gang lags dang*/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams ni/ /gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang*/ /gang dag lha yi spyan mnga' ba/ /sems can bstan la dga' ba rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa 'di zhes pas/ /sang ni dkyil 'khor bzang po'i ming*/

/rgyud sde lnga yi dkyil 'khor ni/ / cho ga bzhin du dril lags na/ /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ /thugs ni brtse bar dgongs nas su/ /tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du/ /byin gyis rlabs par mdzad du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gsol btab/ rab tu lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i bum pa dgos pa yin mod kyang*/ de tsam 'grub dka' bas/ da ltar phyag bzhes la lha bum lnga/ dbus kyi bum pa'i steng du rnam rgyal chen po thod pa'am dung chos/ las thams cad pa'i bum pa ste/ bum pa lhag gnas kyi gzhi mdun du bsdu ba kho na phyag len du mdzad/ de yang tshom bu'am dkyil 'khor so so'i dbus kyi steng du mañdzi sogs la bum pa lnga bkod/ las bum gzhi dkyil gyi byang sgo'i tshom bu'i steng du bkod/ mchod pa dang gtor ma bum pa re re bzhin du bshams pa'am bsdu na thun mong du bshams kyang rung*/ bum pa bskyed chog gi tshul/ sa bon gyi dkyil 'khor bskyed nas/ gtso bo'i snying po brjod pa tsam gyi lha rnams skad cig gis bskyed pa rdo rje gdan pa'i lugs dang*/ bsrung 'khor chos 'byung 'byung bzhi gzhal yas khang du mngon byang lnga las gtso bo lnga bskyed nas/ 'khor rnams mkha' spro byed pa brda byang chub sems dpa'i lugs/ lha thams cad rdo rje cho ga gsum bskyed pa bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta'i lugs/ skad cig gis bskyed pa rā hu la dang*/ su ma ti chen po'i lugs yin par bshad pa las/ deng sang lag len bde ba'i phyir phyi ma mdzad la/ thams cad kyang bum pa gzhal yas khang du bskyed par ni mthun no/ /de yang 'di ltar bum pa rnams bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las/ pad zla'i gdan la bh+ruṃ las bum pa bh+ruṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas rnams mchod cing thugs rgyud bskul/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ thams cad gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/

mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ rnam rgyal chen po dang dbus kyi bum pa'i gzhal yas khang nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser nas/ ljang khu rnams gan rkyal du mnan pa'i snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ rnam rgyal chen po'i sgo bzhir nyi ma'i gdan/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad nas/ sa'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i bar lha sta gon bzhin/ shar sgor rta gdong ma nas/ sham thabs can no 'i bar mtshon cha can gyi bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ gzhal yas khang dbus ma'i nas/ gang ba bzhi dang bcas pa so so'i bar dkyil 'khor lnga po lha sta gon gyi skabs bzhin ji lta ba bzhin du bskyed/ las thams cad pa'i gzhal yas khang par pad+ma dang zla ba nyi ma brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ bdud rtsi'akhyil ba sku mdog ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ dang po gnyis kyis rang snang gi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje nag po rwa gdengs pa dang ral gri g.yon gnyis kyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang sbrul gyi brgyan pa/ khro bo'i mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis dgyes mdzad mtshon cha can lha bcu gsum rgyu sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ shar phyogs kyi nas/ spyi bor khyil ba las/ gtso bo drug la mi bskyod pa dang*/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo dang*/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba la don yod grub pa rnams kyis dbu rgyan/ de nas bum bzlas bya ste/ gzungs thag nas bzung la/ gtso bo drug gi sngags brgya rtsa re dang*/ lha gzhan rnams la'ang nyer gcig tsam re bzla bar bshad na'ang*/ bdun bdun nam gsum gsum tsam ci rigs par bzlas/ las bum la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥbigh+nan+ta kṛ ta hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa brgya rtsa dang*/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra naṃ/ na mo mahā badz+ra kro dha ya/

mahā daṃ ṣ+tot+ka ṭa bhi ṣa ṇa bhai ra wa ra ya/ a si mu sa la/ pa ra shu/ pā sha ha sta ya/ oṃ āḥmṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ hū lu hū lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ gardza gardza/ bi s+pho ṭa ya bi s+pho ṭa ya/ sarba bigh+nan bi na ya ka /mahā ga ṇa pa ti/ dzi wi tān+ta kā ra ya/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa'ang nyer gcig sogs bzla'o/ / thams cad kyi thun mong du/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ zhes pa dang*/ gtsug gtor rnam rgyal gyi gzungs yang ci rigs su bzlas te gzungs thag bsdu'o/ /de nas mchod pa gong bzhin byin gyis rlabs/ mchod bstod dang*/ 'jig rten 'das pa'i gtor ma 'bul tshul lha sta gon gyi skabs bzhin la 'jig rten pa'i gtor chog mi dgos/ bdag dang slob mar bcas pa'i sems can thams cad la gegs med cing dngos grub stsal du gsol/ yig brgya lan bdun gyi mthar ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ rdo rje pang du bzhag pa'am g.yas par me tog dang lhan cig bzung yang rung*/ g.yon pas dri chab kyis gang ba'i dung chos blangs/ pad skor re sngon du 'gro bas/ bum pa re re bzhin g.yas su bskor te/ a khaṃ wi ra hūṃ/ lan bdun gyis bum pa re rer dri bzang gi chu thigs re dang*/ me tog re 'bul/ rab tu dges pa'i thugs can gyis ye shes pa rnams steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs par gyur/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis phyi mchod dang*/ 'bru gsum lan bdun gyis nang mchod/ a nu rā ga ṇa sa gsang mchod phul/ de nyid lnga pa dang*/ khro bo zhe sdang gnas las skyes/ /gsod gcod don du gnyer mdzad nas/ / dngos grub thams cad thob ster ba/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil ba la phyag 'tshal/ / zhes pas bstod/ slar yang dung chos kyi dri chab bum pa so sor blug / nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i ye shes pa'i lha tshogs shin tu dgyes pa'i thugs ka nas/ bdud rtsis chu rgyun byung ste/

bum nang gi lha rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs shing thim pas/ gzhal yas khang rnams bum pa rnams su gyur/ dam tshig pa de rnams 'od du zhu ba las/ rnam rgyal chen po dang rnam rgyal rnams su sngags kyi rnam pa'i bdud rtsis yongs su gang ba dang*/ las thams cad par chu'i rdul phra rab re re nas lha sku phra mo re rer gyur/ de nas bum pa rnams rol mo dang bcas stegs bur spyan drang ngo*/ /yang dam ye ma phye bar mchod yon phul bas lha rnams yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas/ byang chub kyi sems kyis bum pa gang*/ ye shes pa gshegs nas/ dam tshig pa zhu bar byed pa'i lugs kyang yod la/ yang dam ye dbyer med kyi lha rnams byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba ste/ gsum po 'di bum dbang dang*/ gsang dbang dang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gsum dang rjes su 'brel ba'i bum pa'i sgrub lugs yin pas/ dngos gzhi nub gsum la dbang bzhi rdzogs par byed na/ sta gon gyi skabs dkyus bzhin dang*/ gsang dbang gi nyin mo gnyis pa dang*/ sher dbang gi nyin gsum pa ltar sgrub/ dbang rdzogs par byed na gsum pa ltar sgrub dgos zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs don yang de yin la/ deng sang dbang bzhi nub gcig la bskur ba dang len pa ltar na/ bum dbang ma gtogs pa la bum pa'i bya ba med pa'i phyir/ dkyus ltar bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ thun mongs bslab bya spro ba bskyed/ /gsol btab gnang ba sbyin pa dang*/ /rtog pa bsdu zhing sdom gsum brtan/ /rgyun bshags dris lan sdom pa bsgrags/ /sdom sbyin sgo gsum byin gyis brlabs/ /so shing dor la bsrung skud gdags/ khyod chu ku sha gzengs stong dang*/ /rmi lam bstan pa zhes bya ba/ /bcu bdun slob ma sta gon chos/ /zhes so/ /de yang dang po ni/ slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod/ me tog bkye bsdu byas pa la/ sems bskyed gsal btab/ chos 'di'i byung tshul dang*/ che ba ci rigs par brjod nas/

sdom pa gsum la gnas par bya/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin rang gi sdom pa'o/ /zhes bya ba yin pas/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la yang dag par gnas pa la dbang bskur bar bshad pa yin pas/ so so'i cho gas legs par blangs shing ma nyams pa yin na legs/ de ltar ma yin kyang dkon mchog gsum la yang dag par skyabs su song*/ mi dge ba bcu'i las lam spangs pa'i chos dge ba bcu la gnas pas so thar sdom pa'i dgos pa tshang*/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba las sgral ba'i phyir sangs rgyas thob 'dod thun mong ma yin pa dang*/ de thob phyir phar phyin drug sogs byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa khyad par can slob pa'i bsam pa rnam dag bskyed pas sems bskyed blangs pa'i dgos nus kyang 'grub pa yin pa'i phyir/ de rnams kyi bsam pa rnam dag bskyed dgos so zhes gdams/ sngar sdom pa gnyis po phog zin pa yin na/ 'di ma brjod kyang chog go /gnyis pa ni/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*/ /dkyil 'khor 'di 'drar gzhug bya ste/ /bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan/ /'jig rten 'di yis bsam pa spangs/ /dad pa chen po ldan pa dag /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs nas/ /blo ldan dkyil 'khor gzhug bya ste/ /bdag don 'di 'dras gnyer mi bya/ /gal te 'di 'dras don gnyer na/ /gzhan don sangs rgyas 'grub mi 'gyur/ /gzhan don pha rol la dmigs na/ /'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub/ / ces brjod la don bshad gsum pa ni/ 'di'i rjes bzlos bya ste/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ / slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ / mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ / skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ / dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/

/mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ / zhes lan gsum/ bzhi pa ni/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga mchog/khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*/ /de bzhin gang dag ma byon pa/ /da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa kun/ /de dag kun gyi gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen te/ /dpa' bo byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes/ /gsang sngags spyod pa mnyam med de'i/ /ye shes mnyam med thob pas na/ /skyob pa dpal ldan he ru kas/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyin/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig / ces brjod la don bshad/ lnga pa ni/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni/ /shin tu bsam pa bzang dang ldan pas nyon/ /brjed ngas blo la rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlob/ / ces brjod/ drug pa ni/ bcom ldan dkyil 'khor des gsungs chos/ /de sgrub lha mor bcas pa yi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /mchog gsum de la skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag ni dus 'di nas gzung ste/ sdom gsum ldan pas rang nyid sgrub/ /

gzhan la smon pas chos kyang ston/ /'khor dang ldan pa ston par bgyi/ / zhes lan gsum rjes bzlos bya'o/ /bdun pa ni/ sgrub thabs bstan rgyas dang*/ dkyil chog dngul gdong ma'i dngos gzhi'i skabs na rgyun bshags mi 'dra ba re yod cing*/ rdo rje gdan pas/ dbang med bdag gis sogs kun snying gi gzhung ltar mdzad pas/ rgyun bshags kyi rigs rnams 'dam ga yin kyang*/ dngul gdong ma'i 'di skabs su/ yan lag lnga/ bdun gang rung byed par gsungs pa nyid 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir snga phyi thams cad du sbyar na legs pas yan lag bdun pa ltar na sgrub thabs kyi tshogs zhing skabs ltar bya zhing lnga pa la'ang bskul ba gsol 'debs/ bdag 'bul gsum gyi tshigs bcad dor ba nyid do/ /brgyad pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ / gsang ba chen po'i rigs dag pa'i/ /gsang ba yongs su 'dzin par ni/ / bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod dam/ / zhes dris pa la/ bdag nyid chen po bdag 'tshal lags/ / zhes 'don pa spos te lan btab/ dgu pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*/ /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i/ /sdom pa brtan por gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya ni/ /blo chen khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes bsgrags so/ /slob dpon khyod kyis bzung bya ste/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par bshad/ / rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu byin/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam chos khyod kyis bzung bar bya*/ /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba'o/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/

/yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /de las gzhan yang bcu bzhi ni/ /phas pham par ni rab tu bshad/ /spangs shing dor bar mi bya ste/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba zhes bshad do/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re bzhin yang bzlas par bya/ /gang tshe nyams gyur rnal 'byor pa/ kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ khyod kyi srog chags bsad mi bya/ /ma byin par yang blang mi bya/ /'dod pa log par mi spyad cing*/ /brdzun du smra bar mi bya'o/ /phung khrol kun gyi rtsa ba yi/ /chang ni rnam par spang bar bya/ /sems can 'dul phyir ma gtogs pa/ /bya ba ma yin thams cad spangs/ /dam pa nye bar bsten bya zhing*/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams bsnyen bkur bya/ lusakyi las ni rnam gsum dang*/ /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi dag dang*/ /yid kyi rnam pa gsum dag ni/ /ci nus par ni rjes su bsrung*/ / theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ /sems can don la rgyab mi phyogs/ /'khor ba dag kyang yongs mi spangs/ /rtag tu mya ngan yongs mi 'da'/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba pa/ khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya ste/ /phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang*/ / mtshan ma 'god par mi bya'o/ /'di dag dam tshig yin par ni/ khyod kyi rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ /rjes mthun sdom pa rgya cher ni/ /gsang ba'i rgyud las yang dag bshad/ / ces lan gsum/ bcu pa ni/ slob dpon 'dir ni bdag la gson/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ de ltar bdag gis bgyid par 'tshal/ / zhes lan gsum brjod pas khas blangs la/ slar yang sdom pa bzung pa ni/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ / zhes pa nas/ sems can mya ngan las 'das la 'god/ / ces lan gsum/ bcu gcig pa ni/ slob ma skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur pa'i dpral bar zla ba la oṃ las/ 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las sku rdo rje sku mdog dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/

mgrin par sna tshogs pad+ma la a las pad+ma dmar po ās mtshan pa las gsung rdo rje sku mdog dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las thugs rdo rje sku mdog mthing ga rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa rnams su gyur/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du bdud rtsi lnga dang dri bzang sbyar ba'i thig le bya/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du bstim/ mchod pa rnam lnga byin gyis brlabs te/ so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas phul ba'i mthar/ dus 'di nas ni gzung nas su/ 'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos par/ /mchod pa kun dang ldan pa yi/ /dus kun tu ni dge bar mnos/ / zhes brjod yang slob ma rnams kyis rang gi gnas gsum gyi rdo rje gsum la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos byed du 'jug ste/ oṃ sku yi rdo rje sku yi mchog /ye shes dang ldan gti mug sel/ /bcom ldan gtso bo sku rdo rje/ /sku yi rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sku rdo rje slob ma'i lus la thim pas/ lus sku rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur par mos la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bha wa ād+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal 'dzin du 'jug de bzhin du/ gsung gi rdo rje gsung gi mchog /so sor rtog pas 'dod chags 'joms/ /bcom ldan gtso bo gsung rdo rje/ /gsung gi rdo rje= zha ེ sa gsol ba btab pas gsung rdo rje slob ma'i ngag la thim pas/ ngag gsung rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur par mos la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wā ka badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ de bzhin du/ thugs kyi rdo rje thugs dam bskul/ /dag pa'i rang bzhin zhe sdang sbyong*/ /bcom ldan gtso bo thugs rdo rje/ /thugs kyi rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/

thugs rdo rje slob ma'i yid la thim pas/ yid thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/tsat+ti/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swāhā/ zhes me tog 'thor zhing brtan par yang bya'o/ /bcu gnyis pa ni/ ba lci'i maṇ+ḍal thig bzhis le'u tshe dgur bgos pa zhig byas la/ byang chub kyi shing du mos pa'i so shing ā khaṃ wī ra hūṃ zhes brjod pas slob ma'i lag tu btang la/ 'chal ba'i tshul bgyis pas sdig sgrib thams cad skyugs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ ā khaṃ wī ra hūṃ zhes so shing gi rwa bar 'dor du gzhug go /ltas brtag pa spyi dang 'dra/ bcu gsum pa ni/ hūṃ las byung ba'i bsrung skud mdud pa gsum la oṃ āḥhūṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha gsum/ slob dpon gyi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ ye shes kyi sras bu rdo rje gsum dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ lha gsum zhu ba las mdud pa'i rnam par gyur/ skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang*/ bud med kyi g.yas dang*/ byis pa'i mgul du gdags so/ /bcu bzhi pa ni/ oṃ hrī bi shud+dha dharma sarba pā paṃ ni tsa a s+ya shodha ya sarba bi kalpan a pā ya hūṃ/ zhes lan gsum gyis khyor chu byin/ bco lnga pa ni/ dhī las byung ba'i ku sha /oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka hūṃ/ zhes lag pa g.yas su byin te sngas kyi don dang*/ ha las byung ba'i ku sha oṃ āḥkhaṃ wi ra hūṃ/ zhes/ lag pa g.yon du sbyin te stan gyi don to/ / bcu drug pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams/ /u dum ba ra'i me tog bzhin/ /rgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gnyis med zab mo'i spyod tshul ni/ /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas byed/ /gang gis bskal pa grangs med du/

/mtshams med sdig pa byas pa yang*/ /de kun gyis ni dkyil 'khor 'di/ /mthong bas sdig pa byang 'gyur na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos/ /gang gis bskal pa bye ba ru/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsags kyang*/ /'di ni mthong ba shin tu dka'/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /thams cad de bzhin gshegs nyid 'gyur/ / theg mchog 'di la dga' bar gyis/ / zhes brjod la don bshad/ bcu bdun pa ni/ nangs par dkyil 'khor chen po mthong bar 'gyur bas dga' ba rgya chen po gyis la/ ku sha'i gdan la seṅge'i nyal stabs dang dge ba'i sems kyis nyol cig / rmi lam ci mthong ba de yang nangs par nga la legs par smos shig / ces brjod la slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang ngo*/ /gsum pa ni sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar btegs par mos la/ gtso bo rnams kyi snying po'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra be ga a kra ma ho zhes pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya lha grangs dang mnyam pa sbyar bas nam mkhar bzhugs par bsam la/ las thams cad pa'i sngags dang bum chus mtha' nas bskor te phyogs bcings par bsam/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyi mchod/ thun mong du 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ a nu rā ga 'i sngags kyis gsang mchod kyang phul/ mngon rtogs ltar bstod pas bstod/ skabs 'dir rdo rje gdan pa'i dkyil chog dang*/ dngul gdong ma gnyis car na/ gsol gdan rgyas par byed par bshad na'ang*/ sngar gong du snyan mnan pa byas zin na lan gnyis su mi dgos pas/ gong du byed pa dang*/ 'dir byed par 'dam gar dgongs pa yin no/ /'on kyang dngul gdong ma las byung ba'i gsol btab bsdus pa 'di bya ste/ bdug spos 'thul bzhin du spos phor thogs nas/ ma lus phyogs bcur bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ / bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /rdo rje can gyi dkyil 'khor 'bri/ /sangs rgyas la sogs kun 'byon 'tshal/

/dngos grub 'dir ni yang dag stsol/ / zhes lan gsum/ 'di mchod pa rgyun mi 'chad par 'bul na/ lhag gnas kyi nangs par bya ba yin na'ang*/ mchod pa de bzhin mi 'grub na lhag gnas kyi mjug nyid du byed pa deng sang gi lag len nyid legs so/ /lnga pa la/ thig gdab pa/ tshon gyi 'bri ba/ rgyan dgod pa'o/ /dang po la las thig gdab pa dang*/ ye shes kyi thig gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i lugs kyang yod mod kyi/ dkyil chog gnyis car gyi dgongs pa ye shes kyi thig gdab pa'i rjes su las thig gi cha 'byed pa nyid yin no/ /de yang 'di ltar thig skud bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ thig skud kyi gnas dang nam mkha'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs kar bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas te thim/ hūṃ las thig skud nag po mi bskyod pa sku mdog nag po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa la yum mā ma kīs 'khyud pa/ bh+ruṃ las thig skud dkar po rnam snang dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa la/ yum sangs rgyas spyan mas 'khyud pa/ aṃ las thig skud ser po rin chen 'byung ldan ser po nor bu dang dril bu 'dzin pa la yum rin chen sgrol mas 'khyud pa/ dz+riṃ las thig skud dmar po 'od dpag med dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa la/ yum gos dkar mos 'khyud pa/ khaṃ las thig skud ljang khu don yod grub pa ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa la/ yum dam tshig sgrol mas 'khyud pa/ yab lnga rdo rje'i skyil krung gyis bzhugs shing*/ yum lnga yab dang mtshungs pa las pad+ma'i skyil krung can/ thams cad kyang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar lan gnyis kyis mchod/ de nyid lnga pa tshar gcig gis bstod/ lha lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i thig skud du gyur/ thig skud sgril bzhin du/

oṃ a n+yo n+ya/ a nu ga ta/ sarba dharma pa ra spa ra/ a nu pra pṛṭ+ṭa sarba dharma ār+yan+ta/ a nu pra pṛṭ+ṭa sarba dharma hūṃ/ zhes lan mang du bzlas la/ dzaḥzhes brjod pas nam mkha'i lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi thig skud spyan drangs te thig skud la thim/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes lan lnga brjod/ slob dpon nub dang slob ma shar du gnas/ dz+dza dz+dza dz+dza zhes thig skud gtad cing thig sna drangs/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū tra ma ti kra ma hūṃ/ zhes lan mang du bzlas la/ slob dpon gyi rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag g.yas kyis steng dang 'og tu thig btab pas/ sems can don du khyed rnams kyis/ dus yin de ring 'dir spyon cig / ces pa'i sgra byung nas sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs nas thig la thim/ zhes pa thig chen brgyad ka la sbyar la/ shar nub kha bltas tshangs thig dang po btab/ /lho byang kha bltas gnyis pa btab par bya/ /me dang dbang ldan nas ni shar thig btab/ /rlung dang srin po nas ni nub thig btab/ /rlung dang dbang ldan nas ni byang thig btab/ /mer gnas srin po nas ni lho thig btab/ /me rlung gnyis nas log thig dang po btab/ srin dbang gnas pa'i log thig gnyis pa btab/ /gnyis gnyis sbyar ba'i dang po slob dpon gnas/ /phyi ma slob ma'i gnas su shes par bya/ /g.yas skor dang ni rgyab 'gros byed pa dang*/ / phyogs rnams ma 'khrul ba ni nges par bya/ /de ma thig :ye [le ]thig la gong bzhin mchod bstod bya ste/ ye shes pa gshegs/ thig skud de nyid kyi las thig gdab par bya ste/ dbus su phur bu btab la/ de nyid du phyung ste phur khung bya'o/ /bya rjes btsal las thig gi thig chen brgyad rlon thig tu btab/ de nas skam thig thig ring du btab na legs shing*/ min na'ang cha bcu drug tu bgo ba'i bar skam thig tu btab/ de phyin chad thig thung du btab pas rung ngo*/ /de yang*/ lte ba nas rtsa thig gi bar nyis 'gyur du bya rjes byas la/

rta babs kyi rtse mo'i logs thig bya'o/ /de nyid logs gtub gsum byas la cha bcu drug tu bgo'o/ /de la thog mar gzhi dkyil gyi thig byas la/ de'i 'og tu dbus kyi pho brang lnga po'i thig gdab bo/ /'di la rta babs ni snam bu bcu gcig sgo tshad gsum ma'am/ yang na sgo tshad gnyis ma rta babs rgyan ldan du grags pa bya yi sgo tshad gcig ma dang*/ snam bu bzhi ma ni brgyud pa 'di'i lugs la nam yang med do/ /snam bu bcu gcig ma la yang gnyis mnyam dgu mnyam kho na mdzad kyin snang la/ slob dpon gzhan rnams kyi bzhed pa rta babs rgyan can yin cing*/ rdo rje gdan pa'i bzhed pa ni bcu gcig ma'o zhes gsung la/ a bha yā ka ra sa bzhed pa snam bu bcu gcig ma yang rdo rje gdan pa che chung nas brgyud pa'i man ngag yin par phreng ba nyid nas bshad pa sogs gung mthun no/ /gzhi dkyil gyi nang du rdo rje'i rwa ba zlum po le'u tshe dgu dang bcas pa byed pa rdo rje gdan pa'i dkyil chog gis bsal zhing*/ dngul gdong ma las ni/ rdo rje'i rwa ba dang*/ dur khrod brgyad me ri dang bcas pa yang 'bri bar mdzad pa ni/ gzhi dkyil med par khyams le tshe dgu pa'i nang du dkyil 'khor lnga po rta babs can re mdzad pa'i lugs su mngon no/ /'on kyang deng sang lag len la/ gzhi dkyil gyi nang du/ rdo rje'i phreng ba'ang mi byed pa shas che ba lag len gdam nga yin par shes par bya'o/ /gang na'ang gzhi dkyil gyi rtsa thig nang du cha chung gnyis de'i lha snam kyi sar 'jog pa rdo rje'i rwa ba yod pa'i lugs dang*/ lha snam cung zad yod kyang nang gi dkyil 'khor gyi pha gu drwa phyed shar bu mda' yab rnams kyis sgrib pa'i phyir/ nang ma'i mda' yab dang bcas rtsa thig gi bar tu ma 'brel tsam gyi bar snang ma gtogs med par byed pa rdo rje'i 'phreng ba mi byed pa'i lugs gnyis shes par byas nas/ thig bzhis dbus kyi le'u tshe dgu bgos la/

dbus dang phyogs bzhir dkyil 'khor lnga so so'i thig rnams btab bo/ /de yang 'di ltar/ dbus su mtshan ma legs btab nas/ shar nub tshangs thig drang por btab/ /rim pas bya rjes btsal nas ni/ /tshangs thig gnyis la zur thig gnyis/ /logs gtub gsum gyis cha bcu

drug /rta babs sgo tshad gsum ma la/ /phyi ru cha chen re re mnan/ /'dir ni thun mong min pa'i phyir/ /sgo tshad gnyis ma'i dbang du bya/ /dang po gnyis pa cha chen bzhir bgo /gsum pa'i nang du cha chung gcig /bzhi pa rang sar bzhag par bya/ /lnga pa dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ /drug pa phyed gdab phyi ma gdab/ bdun pa brgyad pa cha bzhir bgo /gsum pa'i phyed du gdab bya ba/ /'di ni bdun pa brgyad pa la/ /thig thung gdab par bya ba nyid/ /bcu bcu gcig rtsa ba'i thig yin te/ / thig chen brgyad kyi logs thig go /bcu bdun pa ni mda' yab thig /de gnyis zur nas zur du'o/ /rtsa ba'i thig las phyi rol du/ /zur nas ngos su thig lnga las/ /dang po gsum par reg par bya/ /lhag ma bzhi ni dgu par reg /tshangs thig ngos las thig gnyis pa/ /rtsa thig nas ni bcu bzhi'i bar/ /de nas ngos su bzhi pa'i bar/ /steng du bco lnga pa la reg /rtse nas rtse ru bco lnga pa/ / tshangs las gsum pa bcu gnyis nas/ /bcu gsum pa yi bar du'o/ /de nas ngos su lnga pa'i bar/ / steng du bcu drug pa la reg /rtse nas rtse ru bcu drug pa/ /tshangs las drug bdun brgyad dgu rnams/ / bcu gnyis bcu bdun bar du'o/ /rta babs brgyan ldan zhes bya ba/ /sgo tshad gnyis ma yin par brjod/ /pad+ma zla ba gdung snam dang*/ /nyi ma pad+ma bre gdan dang*/ /bre dang pad+ma zhes bya brgyad/ /rta babs snam bu'i grangs su 'dod/ /tshangs las g.yas g.yon dang po'i thig /bcu dgu pa dang 'dzom sa nas/ /cha chung gnyis gnyis g.yas g.yon bskor/ /de yi sne nas cha chung re/ /bskor te mda' yab la reg bya/ /de snang cha chung phyed kyis bskor/ /glang rgyab dbus bsnol mig gsum 'grub/ / snam bu dang po'i 'og gi ni/ /gdung sna dgu pa'i g.yas g.yon du/ /cha chung re res ring ba'o/ / tshangs las brgyad nas dgu pa'i bar/ /pad snam dang po bcad par bya/ /snam bu gnyis pa drug steng bcad/ /snam bu gsum pa brgyad pa la'o/

/'di la steng dang 'og dag tu/ /cung zad bzhag nas dbus su gcod/ /bzhi pa bzhi nas bcad par bya/ /lnga pa drug nas lnga yi bar/ /drug pa gnyis nas gsum gyi bar/ /steng du rgyas pa'i tshul gyi bcad/ /bdun pa gnyis pa'i steng nas bcad/ /brgyad pa gsum nas gnyis su bcad/ /dang po lnga pa brgyad pa gsum/ /pad+ma yin no thams cad la/ /'og tu cha chung gsum cha'i gdung*/ /steng du'ang pad kheb de dang mnyam/ /nang du bskor thig la reg gdab/ /gsum pa la yang steng 'og tu/ /gdung khebs gdung gdan gnyis kyi thig /gdab bo zhing du thig gnyis so/ /so gsum gnyis nas gnyis kyi bar/ /sum cu gsum nas gsum gyi bar/ / nyer dgu'ang gsum nas gsum bar ro/ /nyer brgyad lnga nas lnga yi bar/ /nyer lnga drug nas drug gi bar/ /nyer bzhi nyer gcig gnyis po ni/ /bdun dang brgyad kyi dbus su bzung*/ /nyi shu pa ni brgyad par reg /de rjes pad+ma phyi ma ni/ /gnyis kyi bar khebs rtse mo la/ kha bad ze'u 'bru'i rnam pa 'dri/ /gdung gdan gyi ni nang thig dang*/ /tshangs las gnyis pa 'dzom sa nas/ /cha chung drug gi nang rwa bskor/ /gdung khebs kyi ni nang thig dang*/ /tshangs phyir bzhi pa 'dzom pa nas/ /snga ma'i tshad kyi phyi rwa bskor/ /sbags rwa la sogs 'dir mi bzhed/ /dbus kyi rdo rje'i rwa rtse ni/ /dkyus su cha chen gcig yin la/ /tshangs las g.yas g.yon cha chung ni/ /phyed dang gnyis gnyis rtsa ba'i zhing*/ /rtse mo'i tshang la nges pa med/ /'on kyang snon por bya'o gsung*/ /dbus kyi rwa rtse'i phyi rol du/ khyams thig pad thig dur khrod thig /rdo rje'i thig dang 'og thig ste/ /skor thig lnga po rim bzhin bskor/ / de rnams tshad ni spyi dang 'dra/ /rtsa ba'i thig gi nang ngos su/ /cha chung re re yongs bor ba/ /nang gi thig tu 'gyur ba ste/ /tshangs las g.yas g.yon cha chung lnga/ /bor bar thig dang drug par thig / bsnol mar btab pas nang gi ni/

/dkyil 'khor lnga yis sa cha 'byung*/ /phyogs bzhi'i dkyil 'khor bzhi po la/ /cha chung phyed re g.yas g.yon phri/ /nang gi dkyil 'khor lnga po ni/ /re re la yang tshangs zur gyi/ /thig bzhi btab nas de rjes la/ /zur thig steng nas gsum gtubs kyi/ /cha ni gsum gsum bgo bar bya/ /de la'ang gnyis gnyis phye nas ni/ /lnga pa dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ /drug pa phyed gdab phyi ma gdab/ /dang po phyed gdab phyi ma gdab/ /gnyis pa'i nang du cha chu nga gcig /btab pas sgo khang 'grub par 'gyur/ /ka ba ka rgyan mun snam rnams/ /dkyil 'khor nang ma rnams la med/ /de dag med phyir rta babs med/ /de rnams spyi'i mtshan nyid do/ /dbus ma dang ni nub ma la/ /lha snam mi 'jog zlum thig bskor/ /'dab brgyad pad+ma'i gcus thig btab/ / nub ma la ni 'od zer gyi/ /pa ṭa'i nang du rdo rje'i phreng*/ /de gnyis cha chung re re'o/ /pad+ma'ang mnyam gsum bya ba yin/ /dbus kyi pad+ma 'dab brgyad ni/ /lte ba g.yas g.yon cha chen ni/ /phyed dang gnyis kyi mtshams nas bskor/ /de nas ze'u 'bru cha chung gcig /de yi phyi rol g.yas g.yon du/ / cha chung brgyad kyi 'dab ma bskor/ /phyi ru cha chung gcig 'byung ba/ /rdo rje'i phreng ba'i thig yin no/ / 'di ni lte ba cha chen gsum/ /'dab ma cha chen gnyis pa'i lugs/ /gzhan la yongs su ma grags na'ang*/ /'di nyid kyi ni rang lus so/ /dkyil 'khor shar dang byang ma la/ /rtsig pa'i nang du cha chen re/ /lha snam tshul du bzhag nas ni/ /dbus su zlum bskor re mig dgu /spyi dang mthun par gdab pa yin/ /de yang bzhi pa la reg par/ /rdo rje'i phyi thig bskor nas ni/ /de nang cha chung gcig kyang bskor/ /tshangs las g.yas g.yon gsum pa dang*/ /bzhi pa'i gdung thig bsnol mar gdab/ /des ni re mig dgu par gyur/ /shar ma la ni 'od zer gyi/ /'phreng ba'i don du rdo rje'i thig/cha chung gcig pa gnyis su bgo

/byang ma'i phyogs bzhi'i re mig tu/ /rdo rje'i rwa thig spyi dang 'dra/ /lho ma'i nang du gdab bya ba/ /lte ba nas bzung rtsa thig bar/ /cha chung bcu drug legs bgos nas/ /gnyis pa'i steng nas bskor ba dang*/ /lnga drug bar dang dgu pa dang*/ /bcu gnyis bcu gsum par dang ni/ / bcu drug pa nas bskor te lnga/ /gtso gnas dang ni 'khor lo bzhi'i/ /phyi thig yin par shes bya ste/ / tshangs thig steng nas bskor bar bya/ /dang po phyi dang gzhan rnams kyi/ /nang du cha chung phyed re bskor/ /ge sar dang ni phreng ba'i thig /skor thig lnga yi bar dag tu/ /dang por 'dab brgyad gcus thig gdab/ /phyi rol gyi ni bar stong gsum/ /'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi sa yin te/ /de yang rtsibs dang rtsibs can gnyis/ /gsum gnyis gsum cha'i rtse mo ni/ /rtsa ba'i zhing las g.yas g.yon du/ /cha chung re res phra bar bya/ /lte ba'i phyogs ni rtsibs can te/ /mu khyud phyogs ni rtse mo'o/ /rtsibs rnams kyi ni bar bar du/ /zhing ni cha chung re re yi/ /ka ba'i thig ni gdab bya ste/ /mu khyud nas ni mu khyud bar/ /skor thig rnams la rim pa bzhin/ /lte ba 'dab ma 'dab shun dang*/ /mu khyud rtsibs dang mu khyud dang*/ /slar yang rtsibs dang mu khyud ni/ /lan gnyis su ni brjod pa yin/ /'dir ni de tsam gyis chog la/ /nang gi cha shas dbye ba zhib mo dag ni/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la bri bar dka' zhing*/ de bzhin du thig gdab par dka'o/ /de'i phyir mi mkho bas ma bris so/ /gang dag bri bas las shin tu mkhas pa'am/ dkyil 'khor gyi tshad chen por 'bri ba dang*/ ras bris la sogs pa dag la ni/ nang gi cha dbye ba shin tu phra ba dag kyang shes dgos te/ 'on kyang so so'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga las 'byung ba rnams kyis rigs 'gre ba'i phyir 'dir ma smos so/ /dgyes mdzad dang sdom pa'i dbus kyi pad+ma'i cha tshad ni lugs 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa yin cing*/

ka ba ka rgyan rtsig pa'i thig la reg pa ni/ rgya bal bod gsum gyi sngags pa rnying pa gzhan mang po zhig la yang yod do/ /de bzhin du rta babs rgyan ldan yang ste/ 'di ni phyis kyi rgya gar ba mang po la yang snang ngo*/ /gzhan yang rta babs tshad can dang*/ tshad med du 'dod pa sngon dus kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams la'ang ci rigs su yod cing*/ 'phags pa'i yul du ni/ sngon ni tshad med du 'dod pa mang zhing*/ phyis ni tshad can du 'dod pa mang ste/ de yang sgo tshad gsum mar 'dod pa mang ngo*/ /'dir rta babs snam bu bcu gcig mar byed pa'i tshe yang*/ ka ba cha chung bdun pa dang*/ mun snam 'khor mo dang*/ zla phyed rdo rje yang mun snam la gnas pa dang*/ 'dod snam ka ba la thug pa tsam byed pa sogs gong dang 'dra bar bya'o/ / zhor la 'ongs pa ste spros pas chog go /gnyis pa ni/ rdul tshon rnams bsangs sbyangs thig skud zhes pa'i gnas su rdul tshon zhes pa ma gtogs/ mchod bstod/ rigs lnga zhu bas rdul tshon du bsgyur ba 'i bar thig skud skabs dang 'dra/ yi ge 'bru gsum lan mang du brjod cing mnyes/ dzaḥ zhes pa nas/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa'i bar yang gong bzhin las 'don pa spo/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes lan mang du bzlas/ phur khung bkang*/ dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa mdzub gang tsam du bris te/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rgyal po nyid/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba/ /tshon gyi las ni yang dag brtsam/ / zhes brjod/ thod pa sogs kyi bkab ste/ rdo rjes mnan/ phyis sbrel ran pa na sbrel te tshon bkra rtag go /rdul tshon rnams g.yas skor du dgye'o/ /de la tshon gyis mtshan nyid ni/ rtsig pa kha dog lnga phyi nang mthun par nang nas rim pa bzhin sngo ljang dmar ser dkar ba'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi lha snam rnams thams cad mthun par/

shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba mngon rtogs ltar dgyes mdzad thod pa can la lho dmar nub ser ba/ ma hā mā ya la shar sngo nub dkar bar mdzad pa'i lugs kyang yod pa shin tu legs par yang mngon no/ /'dod snam dmar po pha gu ser po/ drwa phyed kyi gzhi nag po/ dra phyed dkar po de yang kha phyir bstan pa dang*/ me tog 'phreng ba dang*/ dar dpyangs sogs mdzes tshon/ shar bu sngon po/ mda' yab dkar po/ mun snam nag po/ ka ba nang ma ser po/ phyi ma dkar po/ ka rgyan glang po che mnan pa'i seng ge dang*/ de'i phyi ru/ gdung sna las dpyangs pa'i dar dpyangs mdzes tshon/ glang rgyab phyogs mdog /rta babs snam bu bcu gcig ltar na/ gser snam ser po/ shar bu sngon po/ rin chen dmar po/ rmig pa ljang khu/ mun pa nag po/ wa ra na mdzes tshon/ rdo rje'i rwa phyogs mdog /khyams ljang ser/ pad+ma rnams sna tshogs kyi mdog dur khrod kyi gzhi nag po la me ri rnams kha dog rnam lnga'i rim pas 'bri'o/ /nang gi gzhal yas khang rnams la rta babs med pas ka ba ka rgyan mun snam yang med pa'i de'i phyir 'dod snam sgom khyud kyi rtsig pa la reg pa dang*/ pha gu drwa phyed shar bu mda' yab rnams kyang sgo logs kyi rtsig pa la reg pa'o/ /de nas dgyes mdzad thod pa can la/ rtsig pa la reg pa'i rdo rje'i phreng ba dang gong ras nag po/ pad 'dab phyogs bzhi dmar la me rlung ser/ bden bral ljang la dbang ldan sngo/ ze'u 'bru khra bo lte ba mthing ga /lha snam gyi gru chad phyogs mdog /gsang ba 'dus pa la/ lha snam dang*/ rim pa gnyis pa'i gru bcad rnams phyogs mdog /de gnyis kyi bar re kha nag pos bcad/ de la ma reg tsam rdo rje nag po'i phreng ba zlum po nang le'u tshe dgu lte ba mthing ga /re mig phyogs mdog /ka ba'i mtshan ma phyogs mdog /gdung phyi nang rnams nag po la rdo rje dmar po'i phreng ba rnams so/ /'khor lo bde mchog la/

sgo'i rtsig pa la ma reg tsam nas sku 'khor gyi mu khyud bri ste/ sku 'khor dkar po/ rtsibs bar gyi ka ba dang mu khyud la 'khor lo'i phreng ba/ gsung 'khor dmar po ka ba dang mu khyud la pad+mas mtshan pa/ thugs 'khor lo sngon po ka ba dang mu khyud la rdo rjes mtshan pa/ bde chen 'khor lo'i mu khyud ser po la gri gug ljang khus mtshan pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma gong dang 'dra/ lha snam gyi gru bcad dang sku 'khor gyi rtsibs bar phyogs mdog /gsung 'khor gyi rtsibs bar dkar po/ thugs 'khor gyi rtsibs bar dmar po/ bde chen 'khor lo'i gong ras mthing ga /mahā mā ya yang dgyes mdzad dang 'dra ba las/ lha snam bzhag pa dang*/ rdo rje'i phreng ba med pa'o/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor la/ sgo'i rtsig pa la ma reg tsam du rdo rje'i zlum po dang*/ dbus su'ang rdo rje'i gdung zlum po/ bar bar du gdung thung brgyad kyis re mig brgyad du byas pa/ lte ba mthing ga gzhan rnams phyogs mdog /phyogs kyi re mig gi nang du/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i rwa rnams kyang phyogs mdog /gdung thams cad nag po la rdo rje sngo skya'i mtshan pa 'bri'o/ /da ni lha'i mtshan ma la sogs pa rnams bshad par bya ste/ dkyil 'khor dbus ma'i lte ba la nyi gdan gyi steng du/ sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i thod pa dang gri gug go /'dab ma brgyad la nyi ma'am zla ba'i gdan la/ byang shar nas g.yas skor gyis/ seṅge/ gri gug /dge slong*/ ḍā ma ru/ 'khor lo/ rus sbal/ rdo rje sbrul rnams lha'i sku mdog dang mthun par bri/ dkyil 'khor shar ma'i re mig dgu'i dbus su/ nyi gdan la rdo rje sngon po/ lha gnas gzhan rnams su nus shing spro na mngon rtogs bzhin lha'i gdan 'bri ba yin na'ang/ bsdu na sgo skyong bzhi ma gtogs pa la mtshan ma kho na bris kyang chog ste/ re'u mig brgyad la g.yas skor gyi 'khor lo dang mig 'bras dang*/

rin po che dang*/ rdo rje sngon po dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ yang pad+ma dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ ut+pal sngon po rnams 'bri/ rim paganyis pa'i grwa bzhir/ me long*/ pi waṃ/ dri'i dung chos/ ro mchog gis gang ba'i snod rnams bri/ de bzhin du shar sgo'i g.yas nas brtsams te rim pas/ 'khor los mtshan pa'i klu shing gi me tog dang*/ rin po che dang*/ yang rin po che dang*/ pad+ma dang yang pad+ma dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ yang sna tshogs rdo rje rnams 'dri/ shar sgo'i tho ba/ lho sgor dbyug pa dkar po/ nub sgor pad+ma dmar po/ byang sgor rdo rje nag po rwa gdengs pa/ shar lhor ral gri/ lho nub tu lcags kyu/ nub byang du be con nag po/ byang shar du rdo rje rtse gsum/ shar gyi glang rgyab kyi nang du 'khor lo/ nub kyi glang rgyab kyi nang du/ gtun shing rnams kha dog dmigs gsal med pa rnams sku mdog dang mthun par 'bri'o/ /dkyil 'khor lho ma'i bde chen 'khor lo'i dbus su rdo rje dang gri gug /phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la kha ṭ+waṃ ga /mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la bum thod/ thugs 'khor gyi rtsibs brgyad la rdo rje/ gsung 'khor gyi brgyad la pad+ma/ sku 'khor gyi brgyad la 'khor lo/ sgo mtshams brgyad la gri gug rnams nyi ma'i gdan la lha'i sku mdog dang mtshungs pa 'bri'o/ /dkyil 'khor nub ma'i lte ba la thod pa dang kha ṭ+waṃ ga phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la g.yas bskor gyi rdo rje nor bu/ pad+ma ral gri mtshams bzhir bum thod/ gzhal yas khang byang ma'i lte bar rdo rje'am gri gug gam ral gri gang rung*/ re mig brgyad la shar nas g.yas skor gyis 'khor lo dang*/ yang 'khor lo dang nor bu dang*/ yang nor bu dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ yang pad+ma dang*/ ral gri dang*/ yang ral gri dang*/ lha snam bton na/ rim pa gnyis pa'i grwa bzhir pad+ma la gnas pa thod pa khrag gang shar gyi lha snam la/ gri gug/'phang mdung*/ gtun shing*/
chu gri/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ lcags kyu lho'i lha snam la/ s+t+wa re/ mda'/ dbyug pa*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga

/'khor lo zhags pa/ nub kyi lha snam la/ rdo rje/ cang te'u/ phub/ gzhu/ dril bu/ rlung ras/ byang gi lha snam la sdigs mdzub/ 'phan rtse gsum pa/ glang lpags/ tho ba/ mdung ring*/ me thab rnams 'god pa'i lugs kyang yod/ lha snam ma bton na de dag 'gog mi dgos shing*/ thod pa bzhi yang gru chad bzhi la bri'o/ /shar sgor tho ba/ lho sgor be con/ nub sgor pad+ma*/ byang sgor ral gri ste/ de rnams lha'i sku mdog dang mthun pa re mig brgyad gyi shar dang*/ shar lho la zla gdan dang*/ gzhan rnams nyi gdan la bri'o/ /phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor thams cad la bkra shis kyi bum pa brgyad 'bri zhing*/ gzhi dkyil gyi grwa bzhi po la mchod pa sna tshogs mdzes tshon du 'bri bar bshad pa la/ deng sang lag len ni/ bum pa las thon pa'i me tog zlum 'dzings pad+ma brgyad brgyad yod pa la mtshan ma brgyad brgyad 'khod pa'am/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar bum pa bzang po re re/ 'dab ma brgyad la 'khor lo rin po che sogs brgyad dam/ sgeg sogs brgyad dam/ dngos grub brgyad la sogs pa ji ltar bde bar 'god do/ /bum pa thams cad dang*/ rta babs kyi rtse mo'i ri dwags ni ser po'o/ / gdugs rnams dkar po/ gzhan rgyan rnams mdzes tshon du bya/ gzhi dkyil gyi sgo bzhir yang nyi ma'i gdan la lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu rnams 'bri bar de kho na nyid rig pa dag 'dom par mdzad la/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dgyes mdzad lha dgu'i mtshan ma ni 'god dgos pa ma yin te/ thod pa can lha dgu dang don gcig pa'i phyir ces gsung ngo*/ /rta babs sgo tshad gnyis ma ltar na/ pad+ma'i snam bu dbus sngon po dang ljang khu spel mar bya zhing*/ pad+ma phyi ma gnyis kyi kha bad khra bo/ zla ba dkar po/ nyi ma dmar po/ bre gdan dmar po/ bre dkar po/ gdung gdan dang gdung khebs dmar ser/ gdung snam dngos dang*/ pad+ma gsum gyi 'og gi gdung dang*/

steng gi bad khebs rnams ni gser mdog ste 'di la rta babs kyi rtse mo'i pad+ma 'khor lo gdugs ri dwags rnams la tshad nges pa med do/ /gdung khebs dang*/ pad+ma'i snam bu gnyis pa'i kha bad kyi steng gi g.yas g.yon du dril bu'i snam pa'i mchod rtain gha ṭi ra ser po dang bcas pa re bya/ glang rgyab kyi phyi ngos rtsa bar chu srin dang*/ rtse mor mkha' lding gi gdong dang*/ phyi skor du gser gyi pa tras bskor ba/ nang du drwa phyed sogs dpyangs shing*/ glang rgyab kyi nang gi rtser de bzhin gshegs pa rigs bzhi'i phyag mtshan phra mo re 'bri zhing*/ rta babs kyi snam bu thams cad la ma nges pa'i rgyan sna tshogs pa'o/ /phyi nang gi gzhal yas khang thams cad kyi snod dang sgo khyud kyi mtshams su zla phyed rdo rje dang*/ 'dod snam kyi steng du lha mo'i mtshan ma me tog bcu drug bcu drug dang*/ zur bzhir zla phyed nor bu'o/ /de ltar legs par tshar ba dang*/ tshon gyi lhag ma rnams mchod bstod ye shes pa gshegs pa rnams bya ste/ ji ltar bde bar bzhag go /gsum pa ni/ de ma thag tu las thams cad pa'i bum chus dkyil 'khor dang yo byad thams cad bsangs sbyangs la/ sa rgyan gnam rgyan sogs ji ltar mdzes par bshams/ khyad par rgyal mtshan brgyad bshams pa ni/ shar du dkar po/ mer leb rgan/ lhor nag po/ lho nub dud kha/ nub tu dmar po/ rlung du khra bo/ /byang du ser po/ byang shar du ljang ser rnams so/ /mchod pa sta gon gyi dus las mi nyung bar bshams shing mang po la ni tshad med do/ /bcud sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i bum pa brgyad kyang*/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du dgod/ nang gtor yi dam gtor ma lnga dang*/ chos skyaung bsrung ma'i gtor ma bzhi nges par dgos shing*/ rgyas pa la spros pas lhag por phyogs skyong bcu'i gtor ma bcu dang*/ rgyal po chen po bzhi la bzhi ste/ gtor ma bcu bzhi byed tshul brgyud pa 'di nyid kyi yig rnying dang*/

bla ma'i man ngag las 'byung ba rnams de sang lag len la byed pa nyung bas re zhig bzhag go /drug pa dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i mngon du bya ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dngos dang*/ mchod cing bstod pa dang*/ gtor ma 'bul ba ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ phyi rol gtor ma dang*/ 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad tshogs par byas la/ gong bzhin sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ dkyil 'khor dang yo byad thams cad la bgegs sbyang ba bya ste/ zhi bas sbyang ba/ zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba/ drag pos sbyang ba rnams spyi dang mthun par bya/ 'og slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs su 'byung ba ltar til gyis sbyang bas byur bsal/ las thams cad pa'i bum pas khrus gsol rgyas bsdus gang rung zhig bya/ de nas bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags drag tu bzla zhing*/ hūṃ zhes brjod pas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo skad cig gis gsal btab/ gong bzhin mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i bar dang*/ de rjes bdag bskyes/ nyer bsdu rnams bsgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa la/ dkyil 'khor bskyed dang gzengs bstod pa/ gnas lnga sgrub pa lhag pa'i lhar sgrub pa/ ye shes kyi lhar sgrub pa/ ting nge 'dzin gsum sgrub pa ste drug go /dang po ni/ de nas mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ raṃ las nyi ma nas/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan re re zhes pa'i bar lha sta gon bzhin/ lha'i mtshan ma rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su dgyes mdzad nas/ khyab par mdzad pa'o/ /de bzhin du/ 'dab ma brgyad la nas/ dbus na bzhugs pa 'i bar phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor mtha' dag bskyed tshul yang lha sta gon bzhin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sta gon gyi lha rnams gsal bar bltas te/ bdug spos 'thul bzhin du/ deng bdag skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ /bdag gi gson pa'ang 'bras bur bcas/

/lha dang dam tshig mnos par ni/ /'gyur ba 'di la the tshom med/ /'di ni bdag nyid dam pa ste/ /lha dang skal ba mnyam par 'gyur/ /bdag gis mchod pa bla med 'dis/ / sangs rgyas thams cad spyan 'dren pas/ /deng bdag 'dus pa'i mchog yin no/ / zhes nye bar snyan gsan phab/ gsum pa ni/ oṃ hrīḥswāhā dang gtso bo lnga'i snying po brjod/ rang gi gnas lngar rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor skad cig gis slar yang grub par gyur/ slar yang snying po drug tshar gcig brjod/ oṃ a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ āḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ bdag nyid kyi lus kyi dkyil 'khor lnga dang*/ mdun bskyed rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid kyi ngo bos rnam par dag pa'i phyir rnam pa tha dad kyang ngo bo gcig pa yin no/ / rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya gnas lngar gtugs la/ oṃ badz+ra mahā sa ma ya staṃ/ slar yang gtugs la/ oṃ sa ma ya satwa a dhi t-iṣ+ṭha swa maṃ/ bzhi pa ni/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūṃ/ zhes/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas zhugs te/ gtso bo drung du bdag nyid gnas par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gzhal yas khang sa gsum rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lha tshogs rnams sems can gyi khams thams cad rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid du gyur/ lnga pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags lan gsum bzlas shing rdo rje gsor bas/ bgegs bskrad/ sgo dbye/ mtshams bcings par bsam/ rdo rje'i gur nang gi nam mkha' la dgyes pas bzhugs par gyur*/ ar+ghaṃ sogs dang*/ gtso bo'i snying po rnams kyi mthar 'bru gsum sbyar ba dang*/ a nu ra ga rnams kyis mchod/ de nyid lnga pas bstod/

pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ gyi gdan phul/ rtsa sngags rnams dang*/ mtshon cha can gyi lha mo brgyad po'i sngags bor ba'i sngags thams cad la re re bzhin du a be sha ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes btags la rten la phab ste dam ye gnyis med du bsre/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis dgyes mdzad mtshon cha can lha bcu gsum rgyud sde lnga'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ nas/ 'khor rnams la gtso bos dbu rgyan gyi bar du bum bskyed kyi skabs dang 'dra bar bya/ drug pa ni*/ slar yang gong bzhin mchod bstod byas la/ bdag nyid rang snang gi rig ma dang bcas pa dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur/ yab kyi gsang gnas nas / rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs = gyi bar mtshon cha can gyi sgrub thabs bzhin/ byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer gyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs tshad med cing grangs med par gyur/ mkha' nang nas phyir spros nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad yongs su gang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sna tshogs pa'i mchod pas mnyes par byas/ sems can thams cad la byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer gyi dbang bskur/ sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang la bkod/ de rnams dang sngon nas grub pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sprul pa'i lha tshogs rnams dang gcig tu 'dres/ thams cad slar 'dus/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la thim par gyur/ mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa ci rigs pa bya ste/ gtso bo drug gi snying po brgya rtsa re/ rtsa sngags nye snying sogs tshar re/ 'khor rnams kyi sngags gsum gsum bzla ba'i lag len yod do/ /gsum pa mchod cing bstod pa ni/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs nas bstod pa'i bar ni gong lha sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin bya'o/

/der ma zad mchod pa 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad/ sngags dang phyag rgya ji tsam shes pa de thams cad kyis 'tsham par mchod de mchod pa'i khyad par rgyas pa nyid mchog go /bzhi pa gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ de nas gtor ma rnams byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ 'jig rten 'das pa'i gtor ma 'bul tshul sgrub thabs bzhin te/ cung zad khyad par yod pa sta gon gyi skabs bzhin no/ /gtor ma gnyis pa myur mdzad ye shes mgon po la gtor chog ltar 'bul/ gsum pa mkha' 'gro sde lnga la 'bul ste/ oṃ shrī he ru ka mahā badz+ra a kaṭ+ṭe a kaṭ+ṭe/ pra be sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ ban+dha ya ban+dha ya/ sarba badz+ra ḍā ki ni naṃ hri da yaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ces lan gsum gyis spyan drangs/ oṃ bud+dha ḍā ki ni pra tīts+tsha i maṃ bā liṃ oṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ bā liṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki ni pra tits+tsha iṃ maṃ bā liṃ traṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ bā liṃ hriḥphaṭa/ oṃ karma ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ bā liṃ a phaṭa/ oṃ sarba ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ bā liṃ ho phaṭa/ ces lan lngas phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar dang 'bru gsum gyis mchod/ de nyid lnga pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ltar 'don pa spos pas bstod/ gtor ma tha ma 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma yang sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin no/ / 'on kyang 'dir gshegs gsol mi bya/ phyogs skyong dang nag po chen po dur khrod dang*/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga khyams la bzhugs par bsam/ phyi rol gtor ma ni/ mdor bsdus pa'i tshe/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang*/ 'bring la mos pa'i tshe dgyes mdzad rdo rje nas 'byung ba'i 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma dang*/ rgyas pa la mos pa'i tshe/ phyogs bzhi dang*/ steng ste lngar gtor ma che ba re mchod pa dang bcas pa de 'bul dgos la thams cad la'ang mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ gtor ma byin rlabs rnams gong sa chog gi skabs dang 'dra/
