shar du phyogs skyong la gtor ma 'bul ba yang gong sa chog gi skabs bzhin/ lho ru/ phaiṃ badz+ra a ral+li ho dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥdṛ sh+ya ho/ zhes 'byung po thams cad sbyan drangs/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa bhū ta pre ta bī sha tsa/ un+mā ta/ a pa smā ra/ ḍā ki ḍā ki n+ya da ya/ i daṃ bā liṃ gri h+ṇān+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra ya ts+tshan+tu/ ya thai paṃ/ ya thaiṣ+taṃ bhuñdza thā/ pi pa tha dzi gh+ra tha/ ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarbā kārta ya/ sat+su khaṃ bi shud+dha sa hā yi kā bha wān+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ nub tu mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i gtor ma sngar bshad pa ltar 'bul/ byang du/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis/ phyogs skyong ba bcu srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ bhu dza ra ṇaṃ ya pa ta la tsa ra ṇāṃ/ man khe tsa ra ṇāṃ/ ta purba a ti ga ta nāṃ/ ka da k+ṣi ṇa a dhi ga ta nāṃ/ hūṃ pash+tsi ma a dhi ga ta nāṃ/ phaṭa ut+ta ra ṇa a dhi ga ta nāṃ/ oṃ i hri ya bi k+ṣo kri ta i na ā na de hūṃ phaṭa/ sarba bhu te bh+yo ha ha ha hi hi hi hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ so so'i mthar ar+ghaṃ la sogs pa'i phyi mchod dang 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod dang*/ dam tshig ldan zhing 'jig rten skyong*/ /srid pa gsum na gang gnas pa/ /'gro ba'i don kun spyod pa la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ / zhes bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab pa rnams thams cad la sbyar ro/ /steng phyogs su sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar spyi gtor rgyas par 'bul ba las/ thams cad rang mdog thig ler zhu zhes pa nas/ g.yas brkyang bzhugs shing dur khrod brgyan zhes pa'i bar dor/ gtso bo lnga'i rtsa sngags dang*/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags drag tu bzlas/ yungs dkar gtor zhing bgegs bskrad la mtshams bcad/

slar nang du 'ongs ma thag las bum gyi chus khrus byas la kha bshal/ dkyil 'khor la lan gsum du bskor ba byas te/ oṃ badz+ra ut+ga ha ṭa ya sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūṃ zhes hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dral bas phyogs bzhi'i sgo dbye/ oṃ mchog tu bde ba'i sems ni rol par ldan/ /sgeg pa'i phyag gis bcom ldan 'das la 'dud/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥrab tu grub par mdzod/ /mgon po snyim pa'i me tog bzhes su gsol/ / ho zhes me tog phul/ sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūṃ zhes pas mgo bor me tog bcings la/ bdag gzhan 'khor dang bcas pa la bar chad zhi bar mdzod/ ces gsol ba drag tu btab/ bdun pa ni/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ / zhes lan gsum/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ / slob dpon khyod la skyabs su mchi/ /gtso bo lha mor bcas pa yi/ /lha rnams la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /thar ba chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /rgyal ba mi gnas mya ngan 'das/ /bcom ldan khyod sku bdag la ston/ / zhes lan gsum/ gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /

bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bya/ / lan gsum/ oṃ na ma ste hūṃ/ na maḥme hūṃ/ na mo na maḥhūṃ/ phyogs bzhi nas phyag bya/ bdun rnam dag bya'o/ / rigs kyi bu khyod gang la dga'/ /skal ba bzang la bdag dga'o/ /skal bzang des khyod ci zhig byed/ / sangs rgyas mchog 'dod dam tshig yin/ /oṃ tsak+ṣu ban+dha wa rā ma na ya hūṃ/ oṃ ā khaṃ wī ra hūṃ/ snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba/ oṃ sarba yo ka tsit+ta ut+pa ta ya mi/ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra yo ga bo dhi tsit+ta ya tha su khaṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ zhes pa'am/ a khaṃ wi ra hūṃ zhes pas yol ba'i nang du bcug par bsam/ lha'i dam tshig bsgrags pa ni rdo rje mgo bor bzhag la/ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste/ /khyod kyis spyi bor bzhag pa yis/ /sangs rgyas sku ru khyod 'grub cing*/ / mi phyed ye shes mchog tu 'gyur/ / yang snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par mdzad/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ / mna' chu blud pa ni/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭha/ slob dpon gyi dam tshig bsgrags pa ni/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyi/ /he ru ka dpal nga yin gyi/ /nga yis ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /gus pa'i tshul gyis nyan par byos/ /gal te nga la brnyas pa na/ /sangs rgyas thams cad brnyas pas na/ /mi bde ma spangs dus byas nas/ /sems can dmyal bar gyur ta re/ / ye shes dbab pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /byin gyis rlabs pa'i ye shes de/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la deng*/

/ slob dpon khyod kyis dbab du gsol/ / lan gsum/ dang po'i rdo rje'i phyag rgya snying gar gtad la/ 'di ni ye shes rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yin par bsgrags/ /rdo rje ye shes bla med ni/ /de ring nyid du dbab par shog / slob mas lha la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs la/ bdag la he ru ka dbab tu gsol*/ lan gsum/ rang nyid 'od dpag med dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i rkang mthil du/ dzhaiṃ ljang nag rlung gi rang bzhin/ lte bar ram dmar po me drag tu 'bar ba/ snying gar hūṃ yig sngon po 'od zer lnga 'phro ba sa khams kyi rang bzhin/ spyi bor baṃ las bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po dbus su maṃ yig dang*/ 'og tu haṃ yig dkar po mgo thur du bstan pas mtshan pa/ skabs 'dir spro na/ 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor la yi ge rnams kyis mtshan par bsgom pa dang*/ shin tu bsdu na/ spyi bor yi ge gsum kho nas chog par bzhed do/ / dzhaiṃ las 'od zer gyi tshogs 'phros/ byin pa nas brgyud/ brla'i rtsa bo che nas zhugs/ sum mdor gcig tu 'dres/ lte ba'i raṃ la phog pas/ me lce drag tu 'bar te/ snying ga'i hūṃ bsregs/ spyi bo'i haṃ la phog pas/ bdud rtsi'i bde ba chen po'i rgyun/ skya chil chil babs pas/ snying ga dang lte ba'i yi ge la phog cing*/ lus thams cad du khyab pas/ gzung 'dzin gyi snang ba dbyings su nub cing*/ bde stong gi ye shes lhang gi skyes/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma khro bo dang khro mo thams cad ba spu'i bu ga nas sib sib thim par gyur/ oṃ ā be sha ya ā be sha ya stam+bha ya/ ra ra ra/ tsa la ya tsa la ya ha le ya/ hūṃ ya haṃ hūṃ dzhaiṃ swāhā/ zhes drag tu bzlas/

gu gul dang*/ tshil chen byi la nag po'i brun/ zla mtshan gyis bgos pa'i ras rnams ro sol gyi me la bsregs pa'i dud pas bdug /rol mo sna tshogs bya/ a khaṃ/ yang dag pa yid dkyil 'khor 'dir/ / bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang*/ /dngos grub bsod nams de bzhin shog / ces bden pa'i stobs brjod do/ / sngon nas sgrub pa'i yi dam lha/ /gang yin de ring bdag gi ni/ /rigs dang mthun pa'i dngos grub dang*/ /lha dang ma nor mjal bar shog /oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho/ zhes pas me tog dor/ sangs rgyas kun gyis byin rlabs pa'i/ /me tog rnam par snang mdzad 'di/ /stobs chen khyod kyis rab bcings pas/ /rigs kyi bdag por dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ pra tīts+tsha grih+ṇa s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya maṃ swāhā/ rdo rjes mig dbye ste/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /phye bas thams cad mthong bar shog /oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa tra liṃ hṛ aḥ badz+ra tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya hūṃ/ zhes brjod/ he badz+ra pa sh+ya hri/ zhes pas gdong g.yogs bkrol nas/ lha ngo bstan pa ni/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /mthong nas dad pa rab tu bskyed/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgya'i byin rlabs kyis/ /'gro don phun sum tshogs kun dang*/ /dngos grub thams cad mngon du 'gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad srung ba dang*/ /gsang sngags la yang brtson par bgyi/ / zhes brjod la/ dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi nam mkha' la brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dur khrod rnams su chos skyong ba'i bsrung ma dang bcas pa thams cad bzhugs par mos/ dgu pa ni*/ sbyang pa gnyis ni sngon 'gro yin/ /chu cod rdor dril ming dang lnga/ /dngos gzhi nyid de chu dbang la/ /bsangs sbyangs lhar bskyed byin gyis brlabs/ /ye shes dbang lha spyan 'dren mchod/

/dbang bskur bzlas pa mchod bstod bya/ /gsol btab shis brjod chu dbang bskur/ /slar yang mchod bstod dag pa brjod/ /dbang lha spyan 'dren ma gtogs pa/ /'og ma rnams kyang phal cher 'dra/ /zhes bya ste/ de yang rdo rje slob ma'i dbang bskur ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can/ /yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsol/ /de bzhin bdag la deng stsol cig /bdag gzhan ngan 'gro las sgrol zhing*/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /gnas nas 'gro ba sgrol byed pa'i/ /ye shes dbang mchog bdag la stsol/ / zhes lan gsum/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ grih+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho/ bha ga wā na/ bi d+ya rwa dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ rol mo drag tu bya/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na/ bhasmi ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa'am/ oṃ sarba pā baṃ sarba bi da shīn+taṃ ku ru swāhā/ de nas chu dbang bskur ba ni/ bdag dang dbang rdzas gnyis ka / oṃ mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swabha wa sa sbyangs/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum chu/ stong pa'i ngang las/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ gnyis ka'ang mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang*/ thod pa'i phreng ba dang*/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ yum mā ma ki sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūṃ/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mi bskyod pa yab yum gyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dza/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/

oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe hoḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis ka dang gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rig pa'i lha mo khro bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ sogs nyer sbyong lnga phul la/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag/chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan/ oṃ āḥ badz+ra dhṛka hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes mang du bzlas la me tog la sogs pas mchod/ mi bskyod pa ni ye she che sogs sho lo ka gcig gis bstod/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gsol ba btab par mos te/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ / mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyis so so'i bum pa mang du yod na/ rang sngags kyi bum pa so so'i bum chu bum pa'am/ ka pā lar bsdus/ rnam rgyal bum pa gcig kho na yin na/ de nyid thogs te/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ / sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po'o/ /de yi nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ / 'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye rgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyis chod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/

/'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o/ /bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus bskyed byed bde ba chen po ste/ /de yi deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs sogs bya/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ las bum gyis khrus bya/ de nas rnam rgyal bum pa thogs la/ kun gzhi rnam shes rnam dag cing*/ /me long ye shes ngo bo nyid/ / bcom ldan mi bskyod pa yis ni/ /ye shes chu rgyun dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma shrī ye hūṃ/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams sum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum ni/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ / gtso bo rnams kyi snying po brjod la/ oṃ badzi bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes re re la btags/ thams cad kyi mjug tu/ brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing*/ dbang bskur sku gang dri ma thams cad dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan/ nam mkha'i dbyings gang ba'i sangs rgyas rnams las/ rdo rje'i rigs kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byung nas/ rang nyid la thim/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ sogs kyis nyer spyod lnga dang rol mo 'bul/ mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che sogs kyi slob ma la bstod par bya/ de ltar khyed la chu'i dbang bskur bas/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po rgyal ba mi bskyod pa dang*/ chu'i khams mā ma ki'i ngo bor sangs rgyas shing*/ zhe sdang ma spangs par dag nas/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du gyur/

'di man chad la 'don pa bsgyur bar bya'o/ /cod pan gyi dbang ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ khyed rang dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan/ stong pa'i ngang las/ pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la aṃ las rin po che'i aṃ gis mtshan pa las/ gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rin po che dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang*/ thod pa'i phreng ba dang*/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum gyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ 'i bar gong bzhin/ gnyis ka dang gnyis su med par thim/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ ces gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu rgyan/ oṃ āḥrat+na dhṛka hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes mang du bzlas la/ me tog la sogs pas mchod/ rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ / zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig gis bstod/ rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum snyoms par zhugs te zhu ba las byung ba'i rin po che'i cod pan du gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ thor tshugs cod pan gyis brgyan cing*/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rab bsngags pa'i/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i dbu rgyan dang*/ /dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na a bhi ṣe ka sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di gtso bo rnams kyi snying po'i mthar btags la/

mthar/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣe ka ta hūṃ su ra ta staṃ a haṃ/ oṃ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya ho/ zhes bcings te cod pan gyi dbang bskur ro/ / oṃ sarba nas/ shrī ye hūṃ gi bar gyi chu dbang bskur/ dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rna ltag g.yas su rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu rgyan/ nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad gang ba'i sangs rgyas rnams las/ rin po che'i rigs kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byung nas slob ma la thim/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs dang rin chen rgyal po sogs kyis bstod/ de ltar khyed la cod pan gyis dbang bskur bas/ tshor ba'i phung po rgyal ba rin chen 'byung ldan dang*/ nam mkha'i khams rin chen sgrol ma'i ngo bor sangs rgyas shing*/ nga rgyal dang ser sna ma spangs rang sar dag nas/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du gyur snyam du sgoms shig / ces brjod/ rdo rje'i dbang ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dbang rdzas rdo rje dz+riṃ las pad+ma dz+rīṃ gyis gnyis ka'ang 'od dpag med dmar po/ g.yas pad+ma dang g.yon/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo/ 'od dpag med yab yum gyi rnam par/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu rgyan/ oṃ āḥ.a ro lika hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che

sogs/ 'od dpag med yab yum zhu/ rdo rje/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*/ /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab sgrub phyir/ /rdo rje'i dbang ni sbyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pad+ma a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti stāṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ tiṣ+ṭha bi ra sa ma ya staṃ/ zhes pas gtad/ gong bzhin las ltag par 'od dpag med kyis dbu rgyan/ pad+ma'i rigs kyi/ rdo rje 'od dpag med sogs kyis/ rdo rje'i dbang*/ 'du shes kyi phung po rgyal ba 'od dpag med dang*/ me khams : 'od dpag med kyi gos dkar mo'i ngo bor sangs rgyas shing*/ 'dod chags/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ dril bu'i dbang ni bsangs sbyangs/ dbang rdzas dril bu stong pa'i ngang las/ khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis= gnyis ka'ang don yod grub pa ljang khu/ g.yas ral gri dang g.yon= yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu /don yod grub pa yab yum gyi rnam par/ don yod grub pas dbu rgyan/ oṃ pradz+nyā dhṛ?ka hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ sogs/ don yod grub pa yab yum zhu= dril bur= sangs rgyas kun gyi dril bu'i dbang*/ /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab grub phyir/ /dril bu'i dbang ni sbyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta karma a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti stāṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes pas gtad/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ghaṇ+ḍa a dhiṣ+ṭha na a ṣi ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ rna ltag g.yon par don yod grub pas dbu rgyan las kyi rigs kyi/ don yod grub pa sogs kyi/ dril bu'i dbang*/ 'du byed kyi phung po rgyal ba don yod grub pa dang*/ rlung gi khams dam tshig sgrol ma'i ngo bor sangs rgyas shing*/ phrag dog ma spangs= bya ba grub pa'i ye shes= ming dbang ni= bsangs sbyangs/

dbang rdzas rdo rje dang dril bu stong pa'i ngang las/ bh+ruṃ las 'khor lo bh+ruṃ=gnyis ka'ang rnam snang dkar po g.yas 'khor lo dang*/ g.yon/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo/ rnam snang yab yum gyi rnam par rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu rgyan/ oṃ āḥdzi na dzika hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che sogs/ rnam par snang mdzad yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje dang dril bur gyur/ rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang*/ /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ / sangs rgyas kun tu rab grub phyir/ ming gi dbang mchog bskur bar bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bud+dha a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes bsgrags la/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta he shrī/ yang brtan byed du/ shrī ye hūṃ gi cod pan gyi skabs bzhin/ dpral bar rnam snang gi dbu rgyan/ nam mkha' dbyings/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pa=rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che sogs/ de ltar khyod laming gi dbang*/ bskur bas gzugs kyi phung po rgyal ba rnam par snang mdzad/ sa'i khams sangs rgyas spyan ma'i ngo bor sangs rgyas shing*/ gti mug ma spangs rang sar dag nas/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ mngon du gyur/ snyam du bsgom shig /slar yang slob dpon gyis/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rgyud sde lnga yi dkyil 'khor du/ /de ring slob dpon ming dbang sbyin/ /dkyil 'khor gtso byed ming dbang 'grub/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra hūṃ/ bcu pa la/ gsol gdab phyag mtshan rdor dril sbyin/ /dam tshig gsum dang chu dbang mchod/ /rjes gnang lung bstan dbugs dbyung zhing*/ /brtul zhugs dag pa brjod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ 'khor lo phyir mi bzlog pa'i dbang*/ /dam pa bdag la stsal nas kyang*/ / mgon po 'khor lo lha dag gis/ /de nyid slob dpon 'phrin las gsung*/ /de ring bdag ni khyod drin las/

/rang dang gzhan don nus 'gyur phyir/ /rdo rje slob dpon dbang bskur bar/ /thugs rjes can khyod stsal du gsol/ /rtag tu rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /sems can bzung phyir rjes gnang sogs/ /bdag la de ring bka' drin mnos/ /mgon po thugs rje thugs dam dgongs/ /zha ེsa lan gsum gnyis pa ni/ dbang stegs sogs legs par bshams thub na rab/ ma thub na yid kyis bsam pas chog stai/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su seng khris btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri la rang nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che dang*/ rus pa la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing*/ rang snang gi shes rab dam pas 'khyud pa'i sku can du gyur/ steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can/ mtha' bskor du mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung pos yongs su bskor bar gyur/ hūṃ yig las byung ba'i phyag mtshan rnams su gyur/ he ru ka ni kha twāṃ ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍā ma ru/ /rdo rje khaṃ ṭ+waṃ rdo rjer bcas/ /dril bu sil sil sgra sgrog cing*/ /tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag /gri gug dang ni ka pā la/ / dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis/ zhes brjod/ gsum pa ni/ rdor dril gnyis ka bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum rdo rje snyem ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa'i sku can du gyur/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs te thim/ de nyid zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje dang dril bur gyur/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zungs shig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs/

/de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /mi shes pa'am rmongs pa yis/ /de nyid nges par bstan mi bya/ /rdo rje dril bu mi spang ste/ /slob dpon rnams ni smad mi bya/ /sngags dang sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ /mtshungs par mchod de 'bad pas gyis/ / zhes brjod/ rang snang gi shes rab dam pa la 'khyud pas bde ba chen po nyams su myong bar gyur/ bzhi pa ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje nas dbang*/ /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab sgrub phyir/ /rdo rje'i dbang ni sbyin par bya/ / snying gar gtod/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje bsnyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan dpal mchog dang po yi/ /skyes bu mchog tu 'di 'gyur ro/ /oṃ āḥmahā badz+ra hūṃ/ khyod kyis sems 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi don rtogs par bya'o/ /'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ / dril bu lan brgyad dkrol/ a srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe a/ oṃ āḥsatwa s+t+waṃ/ sgra thams cad grag stong du shes par gyis shig / rdo rje dang dril bu gnyis ka zung du sbyar la/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la/ /lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud/ / bdag med yum mchog khyod la sbyin/ /rdo rje sku yi dngos grub thob/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ yid kyi lus su brtan pa'i phyir/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod/ /gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan/ /des na phyag rgya rab tu bsgrags/ /gzugs su snang ba rnams lha skur shes par gyis shig

/ lnga pa ni/ oṃ phun sum tshogs nas/ bkra shis gsum pa'o/ /dbang bskur rdo rje nas shrī ye hūṃ gi bar chu dbang bzhin/ de ltar dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun gyis lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ dbang rtags su rdo rje 'chang chen po'i dbu rgyan par gyur/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes me tog gtor cing brtan bzhugs bya/ drug pa ni/ bdag 'jug gi skabs 'dir/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod do/ / tshigs bcad rnams mi dgos/ dbang gi lugs 'dir slob ma la mchod pa 'bul ba yin te/ sgeg dang bcas pas phreng ba 'phang*/ /sangs rgyas kun mchod rnal 'byor ma/ / de ni 'bral bar mi 'gyur te/ /phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no/ /oṃ badz+ra kā ru ṇi ka lak+ṣa hūṃ baṃ stāṃ/ rdo rje'i gdan 'di rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sras dang bcas par rnam rol zhing*/ /rdo rje sgeg mo'i rab sbyor gyis/ /dga' ston byed pa'i mchod pa gyis/ /oṃ badz+ra a ghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ sangs rgyas rnams la me tog gtor/ /byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur pa/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi/ /bde gshegs sku ni thob par 'gyur/ /bh+ruṃ rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas/ / brtul zhugs bzang po legs tshims kyis/ /lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su/ /ye shes kyis ni tshim par gyis/ /gha/ rgyal ba rnams la dri phul bas/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang*/ /rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yi/ /byang chub lus can rnams la bgos/ /hrī/ chos kyi me ni legs 'bar bas/ /pad+ma gar dbang rang nyid de/ /sems can ma rig ldong rnams la/ /chos kyi sgron me sbar bar gyis/ /gi /lus can kun la dam chos kyi/ /glu ni khyod kyis blang bar bya/ / des ni rnal 'byor ma rnams dang*/ /myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ /oṃ/ deng nas brtsams te byang chub par/ /rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' tshogs kun/ /shes rab thabs kyi sbyor ba yis/ /bde ba'i gar gyi rol par gyis/

/ho/ de nyid thal mo'i gar gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad chags par bya/ /sangs rgyas 'du ba'i 'phrin las kyis/ /gar mkhan tshul du bsgyur bar bya/ / bdun pa ni/ mig thur me long dril bu dang*/ /mda' gzhu 'khor lo dung po ti/ /sprul bshad dngos grub mchod pa dang*/ /lha sgom sngags kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ / de dag kyang rim pas/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis bu khyod kyi/ /mi shes pa yi rab rib bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hriḥtraṃ/ zhes mig thur dang*/ chos rnams gzugs bsnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*/ /ngo bo nyid med gnas med par/ /de ltar chos rnams shes kyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ / 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skyes/ / zhes brjod de me long dang*/ a las byung ba'i dril bu/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /thams cad mchog gi gnyis med gsal/ / zhes dril bu dang*/ ho las byung ba'i mda' gzhu/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ rjes su chags par byos shig / zhes mda' gzhu dang*/ oṃ badz+ra he tu maṃ/ rkang pa gnyis kyi bar du 'khor lo bzhag / deng nas bsams te sems bskyed pa/ / brtsams te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /de ring phan chad sems can la/ /skyob pa rnams kyis 'khor lo bskor/ / zhes 'khor lo dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bha ṣa raṃ/ lag pa g.yas su dung*/ khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i tshul gyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /dri med kun tu gang bar gyis/ /oṃ mahā dharma hūṃ/ rgyud kyi po ti/ gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga 'di/ /skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan thog drin du gzo zhes bya/

/rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang*/ khyod la rtag tu bsrung bar mdzad/ / zhes pu ti dang*/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan rnams rim pas gtad la/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ / chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ / de bzhin du/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i gnas su/ rdo rje dang*/ rin chen dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ sna tshogs zhes pa rnams bcug la/ rigs lnga'i sprul pa'i sgo nas sems can rnams kyi dug lnga sbyangs te/ ye shes lnga rgyud la bskyed par gyis shig / ces rigs lnga'i rjes gnang dang*/ zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar bya dang gnon sogs dang*/ /bsad dang bskrad pa la sogs pa/ /las de rnams ni sgrub par gyis/ /ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang*/ /mchil lham de bzhin ril bu ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yis dngos grub ni/ /de ni ci dgar sgrub par gyis/ /bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ /rnal 'byor ma ni kun gyis dngos/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /he ru ka dpal bdag mchod do/ /mchod pa'i rjes gnang ngo*/ /'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ khams gsum na ni sdig med des/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral bar/ khyod kyi nam yang ma byed cig /lha'i sku la sems yongs su chags shing*/ zhen par gyis shig /lha bsgom pa'i rje gnang ngo*/ /rigs lnga 'di la stsal lags kyis/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ / lan gsum/ rigs lnga bdag la stsal lags kyis/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ / lan gsum/ sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ / sngags bzlas pa'i rjes gnang ngo*/ /brgyad pa ni/ slob dpon bcom ldan 'das dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i skur gyur pas bla na med pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par gyur/ rgyud sde lnga yi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag nyid dang*/ /phyogs dus sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*/

khyod la rtag tu lung ston 'gyur/ /bdag cag sangs rgyas mgrin gcig tu/ /bde bar gshegs par lung ston to/ /oṃ 'di ltar ngas khyod lung bstan te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu rnam dag pas/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro las khyod 'das/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ bhur bhuḥwa swaḥ dgu pa ni/ gsang chen mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bcug pa dang ni mthong bas kyang*/ /sdig pa kun las rnam grol nas/ /de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba yod ma yin/ /mi thub pa dang mi tshugs pa/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin tu rnam dag pas/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ / bcu pa ni/ dbang rdzas rdo rje bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ de nyid zhu ba las byung ba'i dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur/ de nyid spyi bo dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ snying ga rnams su reg la/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /

rdo rje sems dpa' phyag na gnas/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa stāṃ dha ra ya mi badz+ra sa twa hi hi hi hi hūṃ/ deng phyin chad tha mal gyi spyod pa thams cad brtul nas sngags kyi spyod pa la zhugs par gyis shig /rang gi bdag nyid yongs spangs nas/ /dka' thub kyis kyang mi gdung zhing*/ /ci bde bar ni bde ba bzung*/ /'di ni ma byon rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / zhes brjod la don bshad/bcu gcig pa ni/ sems can don phyir sems bskyed pas/ /sems can bsgral ba'i don de la/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid/ /chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyis phyir/ gzhal med khang gru bzhi pa/ dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhis shar sgo/ yang dag spong pa bzhis lho sgo/ rdzu 'phrul gyis rkang pa bzhis nub sgo/ dbang po dang stobs ni byang sgo/ tshangs pa'i gnas bzhis zur bzhi/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis rta babs/ byang chub yan lag bdun gyis me tog gi 'phreng ba/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad kyis ka ba/ bdud bzhi yongs su bcom pas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/ 'khor ba rnam par dag pas dur khrod/ rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i phyir rdo rje'i thig dang ldan pa/ nyes pas ma gos pas pad+ma/ ye shes chen pos nyi ma/ 'jig tshogs la lta ba yongs su 'joms pas rdo rje/ byang chub kyi sems zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams so/ /lha rnams ni phung po lnga dang*/ khams bzhi dang*/ dbang po drug dang*/ yul drug rnam par dag pa ye shes lnga dang*/ tshad med pa rnams dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug la sogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ / gzhan yang deng nas khyod kyis dbang bskur ba dang*/ rab tu gnas pa dang*/ sbyin sreg dang dngos grub sgrub pa la sogs pa slob dpon gyi las 'di dag mtha' dag sgrubs shig / de nas bum dbang gi dag pa brjod pa ni/

de ltar na rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob/ gtso bor lus kyi dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs/ dam tshig tu rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis bsrung ba la dbang*/ lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pas/ 'bras bus sprul ba'i sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel legs par bsgrigs pa yin no/ / zhes brjod*/ de dag gis bum pa'i dbang 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /bcu gnyis pa ni/ dbang gong ma gsum thun mong gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ bdag ni 'khor bar bying ba yis/ /'gro ba skyabs med 'phongs nas ni/ /de bsgral phyir ni khyod nyid dang*/ /rdo rje 'dzin bdag slob dpon la/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes mchog /gsang dbang bla na med pa zhu/ /brtse bas bdag la gnang bar mdzod/ /dam tshig ji bzhin bdag gis bgyid/ / lan gsum/ slob dpon bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug zhabs bzhi pa mtshon cha can gyi skur gsal ba'i spyi bor dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor/ mgrin par mahā mā ya lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor/ snying gar dgyes mdzad thod pa can lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor/ lte bar 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor/ gsang bar rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum thod pa bzhi dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams skad cig gis grub par gyur/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rgyud sde lnga'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor la thim/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ rig ma skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje bdag med mar gyur/ yab kyi gsang gnas hūṃ nas/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ dkyil 'khor lnga'i lha tshogs thams cad kyi zhal du zhugs/ gsang ba'i lam nas byung ba rnams gcig tu bsdus te/

gzhi lus kyi rtsa a wa dhu ti'i lam nas brgyud/ rdo rje dang pad+ma'i lam nas byung ste/ ga bur dang sih+la gcig tu 'dres pa'i rgyun ye shes bdud rtsi lnga gcig tu 'dres pa'i ka pā lar babs par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ gsang dbang kho na'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ oṃ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor cig bzhed pa/ /mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po/ /rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung*/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod ji bzhin/ /mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du*/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ /nyon mongs ye shes nyid gyur pas/ /byang chub sems chen bdag la stsol/ / lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las/ slob ma dgyes mdzad mtshon cha can zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ oṃ de ba pi tsu badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ a khaṃ wi ra hūṃ gis gdong bcings/ oṃ badz+ra yo ga tsit+ta u ta pa da ya mi/ zhes sems bskyed/ bdud rtsi lce thog tu bzhag / ji ltar bcom ldan dgyes rdor gyis/ /byang chub sras la dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag gis gsang ba'i dbang gis ni/ /sems kyi rgyun gyi dbang bskur ro/ / gtso bo lnga'i snying po'i mthar/ 'bru gsum btags pa brjod/ slob mas kyang a ho mahā su khaṃ zhes bya/ de bzhin du shes rab rdo rje bdag med ma'i gzugasas kyis kyang dbang bskur bar gyur/ ji ltar nas mahā su kha 'i bar gong bzhin/ de nas 'bru gsum gyis gdong g.yogs bkrol/ de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob/ ngag gi dri ma sbyangs/ dam tshig tu sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa bza' ba'i dam tshig rnams sgrub pa la dbang*/ lam gtum mo dang sgyu lus yan lag dang bcas pa bsgom/ 'bras bu longs sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin no/

/ shes rab ye shes kyi don du phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnams/ /gcig bsdus bde ba chen po ste/ /gsang ba'i ye shes bdag la stsol/ / lan gsum/ gong bzhin mig dgab/ de nas mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rig ma gtad/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma/ /bzung zhig bzung zhig sems dpa' che/ / bzung la mchod pa rtag tu gyis/ /thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas min/ /'gro gsum 'di'ang dag pa yin/ /de phyir 'di dang bral bar ni/ khyod kyis nam yang ma byed cig /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba/ de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ / lha mo des kyang*/ bdud rtsi bza' dang btung ba dang*/ khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te/ /sha chen bsten par bu spro'am/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*/ /bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed par/ /bu khyod ji ltar bde byed smos/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ / bdud rtsi lnga po bza' ba dang*/ /bdag med ma la rtag tu gus/ /bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed pa/ /a ho nga yi pad+ma ni/ /bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan/ /ci ste cho ga bzhin bsten na/ /de yi mdun na nga 'dug ste/ /sangs rgyas bsnyen pa la sogs pa/ /bya ba pad+mar byed bzhin gyis/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyin ni/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs/ /oṃ āḥbhañdza mo k+ṣa haṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas/ slob ma dgyes mdzad rdo rje mtshon cha can zhal phyag thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ rig ma rdo rje bdag med mar gyur/ gnyis ka'i rtsa 'khor lo lnga rab tu gsal ba la rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ sgrub thabs bzhin mkha' gsang byin gyis rlabs/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drang*/

slob ma dang*/ rig ma'i gnas lngar thim pas bde ba chen pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ yab yum snyom par zhugs/ rjes chags gtum mo rab tu 'bar bas spyi bo'i haṃ yig zhu/ mgrin par phyin pas dga' ba/ snying gar phyin pas mchog dga'/ lte bar phyin pas khyad dga'/ nor bus phyin pas lhan cig skyes dga' mngon du byas/ slar yang hūṃ zhes bya bas gyen du gshegs par gyur te/ 'khor lo bzhir rim pas mas brtan pa'i dga' ba shar te/ spyi bor lhan cig skyes pa brtan par gyur/ 'bru gsum gyis gdong g.yogs bkrol/ de ltar na bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur thob/ yid kyi dri ma sbyangs/ dam tshig tu dngos dang ye shes kyi rig ma bsten pa la dbang*/ lam las dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang 'od gsal sgom/ 'bras bu chos sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin no/ / bzhi pa chen po tshig dbang zhu bar maṇ+ḍal phul/ khyod zhabs pad+mo'i bka' drin gyis/ /gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*/ /gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol/ / de nas bzhi pa tshig tsam gyis sbyin pa ni/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*/ /rdo rje snying po mkha' dang mtshungs/ /rdul med mthar phyin zhi ba nyid/ khyod kyi pha ni khyod nyid do/ /de nas bzhi pa'i ye shes de/ /man ngag sngon du sbyin pa ni/ /phyag rgya bzhi don gcig nyid du/ /brgyud pa yod pas de la bstan/ /phyag rgya bzhi don rim pa lnga/ /lam lnga skad cig de la bsgom/ khyod kyi srog chags bsad par bya/ /rdzun gyi tshig kyang smra bar bya/ /ma byin par yang khyod kyis long*/ /pha rol bud med bsten par bya/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la rol/ /mi bza' ba ni gang yang med/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi bsrung*/ /des ni tha mal spangs nas 'grub/ /de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs/

dbang bzhi pa thob sgo gsum gyi dri ma'i bag chags thams cad sbyangs/ dam tshig tu dgongs te gsungs pa'i dam tshig rnams kyang spyod pa la dbang*/ lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po bsgom/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin no/ / de nas/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba dang*/ deng nas brtsams te sogs dang*/ dge ba bsngo ba rnams bya'o/ /bcu gsum pa ni/ mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ gong bzhin byin gyis rlabs/ mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar tshigs bcad dang bcas pa gong bzhin brjod/ de bzhin du nang mchod kyang sngar bzhin phul/ de nyid lnga pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ bcom ldan 'das dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ bcom ldan 'das dpal sgyu 'phrul chen po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ bcom ldan 'das dpal gshin rje gshed rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams dang*/ dpal myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po zhing skyong ba 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ dpal gtsang rigs kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga la sogs pa phyi nang gsang ba'i dam can gyi tshogs dang bcas pa rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag dang sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi gnas la 'god par mdzad du gsol/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar ba dang*/ sems can thams cad la bde skyid 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ khyad par rig pa 'dzin pa'i theg pa lung dang rtogs pas bsdus pa mtha' dag byin rlabs mi nyams shing shin tu dar bar mdzad du gsol/

bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa tshe 'di nyid la stsal du gsol/ rgyud kyi rgyal po rnams las ji skad bshad pa'i las thams cad thogs pa med par 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes dngos grub zhu/ yi ge brgya pa lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sogs 'don zhing*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs dang*/ lhag pa dang ni sogs dang*/ gtso bor nus pa ma mchis pa sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i thad du gnas pas/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du mos pas/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gyis mthar rol mo'i sgra dang bcas/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twa ta oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa muḥ zhes brjod cing thog mar dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa bshig /de rjes su thig chen brgyad kyi sa nas dbyi'o/ mthar ci bderaphyags shing lha mtshan rnams logs su bsdu'o/ /de byin rlabs kyi don du rang gi spyi bor cung zad blugs la/ don du gnyer ba rnams la'ang cung zad byin/ de nyid bum pa bzang por blug ste bkur sti dang bcas klu brgyad mchod pa'i cho gas chu bor spyan drangs shing gtad do/ /slar 'ong ste thig rjes rnams mi mngon par byas la/ lha mo sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sngags kyis phur bu phyung zhing*/ sngags de nyid kyis phur khung kyang 'o mas bkang ngo*/ /sgrub mchod nyid zhag sbrel mar byed na yang gshegs gsol gyi nyin mo ma gtogs gshegs gsol gyi don du brtan bzhugs bya zhing*/ dngos gzhi nyin rting ma rnams la nam mkha'i lha 'bebs pa'i skor rnams mi dgos so/ /smon lam btab cing bkra shis kyang rgya cher brjod la shul de nyid du sbyin sreg dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa dga' ston rgya cher bya'o/

/de ltar bshad pa'i dge 'dis kyang*/ /dpag g.yas sems can ma lus rnams/ /yan lag bdun ldan sku bzhi'i dngos/ /rdo rje 'chang chen thob par shog///dpal rgyud sde lnga'i bdag 'jug ngag 'don 'di yang nye mkhor mthong nas tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ / bkra shis/ gcig zhus/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga don gsal rgyas byed ces bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 174 -- PAGE 175 -- PAGE 104 -
